jobs.title: Hospitalist Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**El Camino Health Medical Network is recruiting a talented Hospitalist Program Coordinator in Santa Clara County.**


Pay: $37\.00 \- $47\.00/hour


Location: Los Gatos, CA


**El Camino Health Medical Network (ECHMN**) is a growing healthcare provider organization delivering high\-quality, community\-based ambulatory care across the Greater Silicon Valley. We are committed to coordinating care that meets the needs of the diverse communities we serve, while simplifying the healthcare experience for both patients and providers.


At ECHMN, we value collaboration, accountability, and innovation. Our teams work closely across disciplines to support physicians, improve access to care, and deliver a consistently high standard of service. We offer a supportive and engaging work environment where individuals are empowered to make an impact and contribute to meaningful growth.


If you are passionate about healthcare, driven by purpose, and eager to work in a collaborative, patient\-centered organization, we invite you to explore a career with El Camino Health Medical Network.

  


**Summary**


The **Hospitalist Program** **Coordinator** provides operational, administrative, and physician support for the day\-to\-day activities of the Hospitalist Program. This position serves as a key liaison between hospitalist physicians and advanced practice providers (APPs), Medical Network leadership, hospital departments, Medical Staff Services, Human Resources, Finance, Payroll, and other operational partners.


The **Hospitalist Program** **Coordinator** supports physician and APP scheduling, onboarding and credentialing coordination, timekeeping and payroll processes, meeting administration, program communications, operational reporting, and ongoing program initiatives.


The position works closely with the Hospitalist Medical Director and operational leadership to support effective physician coverage, timely resolution of operational issues, and efficient coordination of hospitalist services.

  


**Hospitalist Program Operations**


* Provide day\-to\-day administrative and operational support for the Hospitalist Program.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for hospitalists and APPs regarding program operations, scheduling, administrative processes, and general program questions.
* Partner with the Hospitalist Medical Director and operational leadership to coordinate program priorities and activities.
* Identify operational issues and escalate matters requiring Medical Director or leadership review.
* Coordinate hospitalist program meetings, including scheduling, agendas, materials, meeting minutes, and follow\-up items.

  




**Physician and APP Scheduling**


* Develop, maintain, and distribute physician and APP work schedules in partnership with the Medical Director and program leadership.
* Coordinate schedule changes, vacations, planned absences, and coverage needs.
* Assist with identifying coverage gaps and communicating open shifts to appropriate providers.
* Track schedule changes and ensure accurate communication to physicians, hospital departments, Medical Staff Services, Payroll, and other stakeholders as appropriate.
* Maintain accurate physician coverage and on\-call schedules.
* Support provider schedule reconciliation and related reporting.


**Physician and APP Onboarding**


* Coordinate the administrative onboarding of new hospitalists and APPs.
* Work collaboratively with Physician Recruitment, Human Resources, Medical Staff Services, IT, hospital departments, and leadership to facilitate timely onboarding.

* Maintain onboarding checklists and monitor outstanding requirements.
* Support offboarding and transition activities for departing providers.
* Assist providers with navigating administrative requirements related to credentialing, onboarding, compliance training, and hospital access.
* Maintain program records in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support audits and compliance reviews as requested.


**Administrative Support**


* Coordinate physician meetings, departmental meetings, interviews, orientations, and special events.
* Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, spreadsheets, and other program materials.
* Maintain confidential physician, employee, and business information.
* Assist with purchase orders, invoices, expense reimbursement, supplies, and other departmental administrative activities as assigned.
* Participate in process\-improvement initiatives designed to improve program efficiency and physician experience.

  




**Minimum Requirements**


**Education:**


* Associate's or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, human resources, health services, or a related field.


**Experience:**


* Three or more years of progressively responsible administrative, healthcare operations, physician practice, medical staff, or program coordination experience.
* Experience coordinating multiple priorities, schedules, and stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.

jobs.description:
**Abode Services**, one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a Program Manager for our Veterans Shelter program in San Jose, CA.


**About Abode:**

At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.


**Our Values:**

We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!


**The Diverse Culture:**

We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.


**About The Role**:



The Program Manager will provide leadership, support, and oversight to a multidisciplinary team to assist adults and their families who are homeless and/or formerly homeless. This team will engage, and support participants maintaining housing /shelter placement, develop and execute housing stability plans and provide wraparound supportive services. Key responsibilities include supervision of staff and oversight of services delivery, close coordination with case management partners and budget and oversight of public contracts.


**How You Make An Impact**:


* Provide direct supervision to all Program staff and interns.
* Provide regular and appropriate feedback including training, opportunities for professional growth, verbal, and written improvement plans when needed, and regular evaluations.
* Ensure that all program staff under your leadership are meeting the goals as set forth in their program’s respective grants.
* Coordinate training, schedules, caseloads, vacations, and assignments as part of program administration.
* Provide support to staff when dealing with client crises, problem solving with managers on challenging participant situations, and develop on\-going housing stability interventions with staff.
* Build collaborative relationships with property management and on\-site resident services staff if applicable. Advocate for participants housed at various sites as needed.
* Supervise staff and provide feedback, coaching, training, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Work with staff to ensure timely and accurate data entry is occurring.
* Work with Data Specialists on reporting to funders and stakeholders on program activities.
* Monitor Programs contracts to ensure maximization of funding and program deliverables are met and support with program audits.
* Assist in developing policy and procedures and other aspects of programs.
* Facilitate case conferencing and administrative meetings.
* Assist in developing materials, assessment tools, job descriptions, and other program processes/documents/tools.
* Other duties as assigned.


**How You Meet Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field and equivalent experience.
* 3 years of professional experience in the human services, social work, or related field and demonstrated experience working collaboratively with low\-income families and providing service coordination.
* 2 years of direct experience in the provision and supervision of case management services to individuals who are homeless and/or have extremely low incomes.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of a valid and current California Driver’s License and current insurance along with a clean DMV record required.

COMPETENCIES:


* Excellent verbal and written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Ability to interact effectively with a diverse population with multiple special needs, and be comfortable building successful collaborative relationships with participants, staff, property managers, and with the larger community and county systems while networking and building resources.
* Deep understanding of the following evidence\-based practices: Housing First, Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, and Trauma Informed Care.
* Understanding and practice of culturally sensitive components of direct service delivery through open dialogs and self\-exploration with diverse groups.
* Experienced in effectively intervening in crisis situations using de\-escalation techniques.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business\-related applications.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.

jobs.description:
**About Us**



One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn't your average doctor's office. We're on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved \- from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in\-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on\-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.



In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we're building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.


**The Opportunity**



As a Member Support Specialist (Administrative Assistant) you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in\-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.



You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer\-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self\-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.



What you'll likely work on:


* Use impeccable C\-I\-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in\-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary
* All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc
* Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.
* Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G\-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work
* Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization


These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.



What you'll need:


* At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback\-driven multi\-disciplinary teams
* A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges
* Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously
* Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $24\.00 per hour based on a full time schedule.


This is a full\-time role based in\-person with our team and patients at offices in the Financial District at 201 Spear Street, Transbay Center, Mission Bay, and Sutter Street Monday to Friday 7:30 AM to 6:30 PM. Office location and schedules are subject to change.



Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Administrative & HR Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Administrative Officer uses advanced concepts and organizational objectives to resolve complex issues. Manages, plans, administers, and coordinates the administrative operations in the Department of Otolaryngology \-Head \& Neck Surgery. The department is within the School of Medicine. The position reports to the Chief Administrative Officer.


The department has a continuous stream of staffing and academic activity that requires the ability to work in partnership with Human Resources Shared Services and the Office of Faculty and Academic Affairs, with expertise in recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, leaves of absence, recognition, HR Oracle transaction processing, and other related areas.


Additional responsibilities include providing executive and senior leadership with HR/Academic Affairs strategic consultation, assigning HR\-related project management goals, providing high\-level data reporting, and independently executing all newly assigned duties as directed by the Chief Administrative Officer and department Chair. Also, provides ongoing strategic policy and operational process consultation. Provides triage consultation to executive leadership and advises management on complex performance management, disciplinary actions, union grievances, and internal investigations. This position will manage these HR\-related matters and play a critical leadership role in ensuring the department's workforce is highly skilled, compliant, productive, and motivated.


The predominant focus of this position is the performance of administrative operations activities; performs short\- and long\-term planning for the department. Regularly works on highly complex issues in which multiple situations or data require an in\-depth evaluation of multiple variables. Exercises sound judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve goals may result in additional costs and negatively impact departmental operations and employee morale.


**Department Overview**


The Department of Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery is a clinical department at UCSF that combines superior resident and medical student training with the highest\-quality patient care. Beyond our offices, clinics, and laboratories within the 107\-acre UCSF Parnassus campus above Golden Gate Park, our department reaches into the Moffitt Long Hospital, the Ambulatory Care Center, the Medical Center at Mount Zion, and shares UCSF’s partnerships with Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (SFVAMC).


Divisions within OHNS include Pediatric Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, Laryngology, Otology/Neurotology, Rhinology, Minimally Invasive Skull\-Based Surgery, Facial Plastic Surgery, and Sleep Disorders. The department ranked \#1 in Northern California by U.S. News \& World Report in 2021 and \#5 in the nation. We also have a robust research enterprise with 10 PhD faculty and a $10M sponsored research budget for FY26\. OHNS has consistently been ranked in the top 10 institutions for NIH funding. The department has an ACGME\-accredited residency program with 25 residents. Additionally, four fellows receive subspecialty training annually.


  
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience / training
* Minimum of five years of related work experience
* Advanced interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills
* Advanced knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as event planning, basic fundraising processes, risk management planning, website design, accounting and payroll, and contracts and grants regulations and guidelines
* Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality
* Advanced skills in short\- and long\-term strategic planning, analysis, problem\-solving and customer service
* Advanced knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques, and / or human resources policies and procedures for staff and academic employees
* Ability to work independently, conduct benchmarking, wage \& benefit analysis and derive recommendations to senior leadership
* Ability to work collaboratively with external teams in HR Shared Services, Labor \& Employee Relations, union representatives, and legal counsel
  

**Peferred Qualifications:**

* Human Resources professional certification
* Advanced knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for budget, accounting and fund management, and / or personnel management
* Advanced knowledge of common University\-specific computer application programs

jobs.title: Kitchen Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a highly organized, hands\-on Kitchen Operations Manager to oversee back\-of\-house operations at multiple locations under the supervision of our Culinary Director. This is a hands\-on, on\-site chef role.

This role requires strong cooking fundamentals and the ability to turn standards into dependable routines.

***Please Read Before You Apply***

* **Schedule:** Approximately 50 hours per week on average, with additional demands during the holiday season.
* **Multi\-location responsibility:** Your schedule and the division of your time between locations will depend on business needs.
* **Travel:** You must be willing and able to travel between San Mateo and San Francisco several times each week.
* **Core expectations:** This role centers on disciplined systems, precision, consistency, attention to detail, and follow\-through.

***Responsibilities***

* Oversee daily back\-of\-house operations across both locations, including:
* Manage inventory and ordering, keep accurate records, ensure appropriate stock levels.
* Control waste.
* Develop and maintain accurate prep lists for dinner service and events.
* Coordinate preparation and kitchen execution for events.
* Maintain standards for food quality, flavor, portioning, and presentation.
* Uphold food safety, sanitation, and allergen\-handling procedures.
* Communicate priorities, delegate, and follow through clearly.
* Work with the Culinary Director to identify gaps and improve systems.

***Professional Qualifications (required; in order of importance)***

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated experience with inventory management, ordering, prep planning, and event preparation and execution
* Strong command of core cooking fundamentals.
* Mastery of food safety, sanitation, and allergen management.
* At least one year of experience as a Kitchen Manager, Sous Chef, Chef de Cuisine, or another senior back\-of\-house leadership role.

***How to Apply***

Submit your 1\) resume and 2\) either a cover letter **or** a short note addressing:

* Why you’re interested in this position.
* Why your experience and working style make you a strong fit.

Applications must include both items 1\) and 2\) to be considered.

***Hiring Process***

* Initial phone screening: Discuss the role, basic expectations, compensation expectations, and your questions.
* Formal interview: Communicate your leadership style, approach to work, professional philosophy, and career goals.
* Tasting interview: Demonstrate your cooking fundamentals and culinary skillset.
* Paid working interview: Complete a three\-hour stage following the tasting interview.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

* Explain why you are interested in this position.

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. Our initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, we opened our custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, we opened our peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, we expanded our production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, we passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, we added additional cGMP clinical production capacity in Milpitas, CA.


We seeking a hands\-on Clinical Operations Manager to lead the planning and execution of longevity and oncology clinical programs. Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, this person will translate clinical strategy and protocols into practical operating plans, lead study and site start\-up, coordinate sites and vendors, manage timelines and budgets, and ensure consistent execution from feasibility through closeout. The Manager will support the build while preserving the medical, safety, regulatory, and investigator authority of qualified owners.


Job Duties:

* Lead clinical operations across longevity and oncology studies from feasibility and planning through study start\-up, enrollment, conduct, closeout, and archival.
* Translate protocols into detailed operating plans, study timelines, responsibility matrices, site workflows, visit requirements, staffing plans, vendor plans, and readiness criteria.
* Lead site identification, feasibility, qualification, selection, budget and contract coordination, initiation, activation, ongoing management, and closeout.
* Coordinate investigators, clinical sites, CROs, central and specialty laboratories, pharmacies, imaging providers, couriers, technology vendors, and other study partners.
* Own study start\-up and site\-activation tracking, including essential documents, regulatory and ethics submissions, contracts, budgets, training, supplies, systems access, delegation, and activation dependencies.
* Develop and manage clinical operations budgets, forecasts, purchase requests, vendor scopes, invoices, and change orders within approved company controls.
* Establish enrollment, visit, monitoring, data, specimen, investigational\-product, issue, risk, and milestone tracking appropriate to each study.
* Oversee participant\-recruitment readiness, site performance, enrollment progress, protocol adherence, data\-cleaning support, query resolution, and corrective action follow\-through.
* Plan and oversee monitoring activities using internal personnel or CROs, including monitoring plans, visit reports, findings, escalation, and closure of action items.
* Ensure the Trial Master File and site files are complete, current, controlled, and inspection ready in coordination with Regulatory, Quality, and study\-site personnel.
* Identify and escalate operational, safety, medical, regulatory, quality, supply, and timeline risks to the appropriate qualified owner; maintain clear decision and action logs.
* Lead cross\-functional study meetings and provide concise status reporting to the CMO and leadership on milestones, enrollment, budget, risks, decisions, and recovery plans.
* Create and maintain fit\-for\-purpose clinical operations SOPs, work instructions, templates, training, metrics, and vendor oversight practices with Quality and Regulatory review as applicable.
* Hire, train, supervise, and develop clinical operations personnel, including clinical research coordinators and study\-management staff; establish clear responsibilities and backup coverage.
* Support audits, inspections, due diligence, and sponsor or partner reviews by providing complete operational records and timely responses.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, nursing, pharmacy, public health, clinical research, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 5\+ years of progressive clinical operations experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, a CRO, an academic research center, or a clinical\-site organization.
* 2\+ years of experience leading clinical studies, sites, vendors, projects, or clinical operations personnel.

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Swift Navigation**  

is hiring. Let us introduce ourselves. Swift is changing the way we navigate and understand the world. Swift’s precise positioning technology platform improves location accuracy from several meters to centimeter\-level and is used by millions of devices across the globe. Swift’s technology is trusted by users across industries, enabling safer driving, improving efficiency for last\-mile delivery and commercial transport operations, increasing accuracy for mobile devices and creating new possibilities for rail, robotics and machine control. That’s what we offer our customers and partners, but it’s the work we do together as a team that is the best part of our days. We collaborate—across the globe—to tackle problems, to pursue our mission and to make a real impact in the world. We are diverse, flexible, supportive and we believe our team is our most important asset and offer a host of benefits and programs to ensure that they know it.

  



Swift Navigation is looking for an outstanding Senior People Operations Manager to own and run the full scope of HR for our global team across 12 countries, from onboarding and employee relations to performance management, payroll, benefits and engagement. As our sole HR professional, the People Operations Manager will play a key role by delivering a consistent, compliant and positive employee experience in every country where we operate, keeping our people data accurate and reliable, and helping managers build a culture where our team can do its best work.

  


**Duties/Responsibilities:**


* Serve as the company’s sole People Operations lead and the first point of contact for employees and managers on all HR matters across 12 countries.
* Own end\-to\-end onboarding, including offer paperwork, pre\-boarding, new hire orientation and 30/60/90\-day check\-ins, in partnership with hiring managers, IT and Finance.
* Advise managers and employees on employee relations matters; conduct investigations, document outcomes and resolve concerns fairly, confidentially and in line with local law.
* Run the performance management cycle, including annual reviews, calibration support and performance improvement plans, and coach managers on giving effective feedback.
* Partner with Finance and our payroll providers to support accurate, on\-time payroll in each country by collecting and validating inputs (new hires, terminations, compensation changes, leave, bonuses) and resolving discrepancies.
* Administer and maintain the HRIS as the single source of truth for employee data; ensure data integrity, manage system updates and integrations, and produce headcount and people reports for leadership.
* Manage the PEO relationship and any Employer of Record (EOR) partners, serving as the primary contact for service issues, renewals, compliance questions and escalations.
* Administer benefits programs, including open enrollment, vendor management, employee questions and periodic benchmarking to keep our offerings competitive in each market.
* Manage offboarding, including exit interviews, coordination of final pay and documentation, and analysis of exit trends to identify retention risks and opportunities.
* Design and lead employee engagement initiatives, such as engagement surveys, recognition programs and virtual and in\-person events that connect a globally distributed team.
* Maintain the employee handbook, country\-specific policies and HR processes; monitor employment law changes in the countries where we operate and keep the company compliant.
* Support compensation reviews, promotions and leave administration in partnership with leadership and Finance.
* Other duties as needed.

  


**Required Skills/Abilities:**


* 6\+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years as an HR generalist or manager, ideally as a solo or small\-team HR lead.
* Experience supporting a distributed, multi\-country workforce, including working with PEOs and/or EORs.
* Strong working knowledge of US employment law and familiarity with employment practices in other regions (such as Europe and APAC), plus the ability to research local requirements quickly.
* Hands\-on experience administering an HRIS (BambooHR a plus) and supporting multi\-country payroll.
* Sound judgment in handling sensitive employee relations matters with discretion, empathy and objectivity.
* Self\-directed and highly organized, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and deliver without a larger team to lean on.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build trust with employees at every level, across cultures and time zones.
* Comfort working with data in Google Sheets or Excel to maintain records, spot trends and create reports.
* Flexibility to occasionally work outside standard hours to support colleagues in other time zones.
* Experience supporting ISO certification and surveillance audits (such as ISO 9001 or ISO/IEC 27001\), including keeping training, competency and onboarding records audit\-ready and helping maintain people\-related controls and documentation.
* Experience administering immigration and work authorization processes, including Form I\-9/E\-Verify compliance, coordinating US visa and green card cases (such as H\-1B, TN, O\-1 and PERM) with outside immigration counsel, and supporting work permits and visas for international hires and business travel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience. PHR/SPHR or SHRM\-CP/SCP certification and experience in a technology company are a plus.

  


**Perks:**


* A flexible work environment includes work\-from\-home days each week.
* Flexible vacation, competitive salary and benefits packages, stock options.
* Tech talks, mentorship programs, employee events.
* Growth and learning opportunities from a tech environment include working closely with an international team of scientists, engineers, platform architects, programmers,

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager - Contract Position
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**At Nile, we envision an enterprise network that inherently defends against cyber threats, eliminates lateral attack vectors like ransomware, and operates free of complexity. Our goal is to deliver Campus Network\-as\-a\-Service (NaaS) that makes network operations virtually invisible to our customers by pushing the boundaries of autonomy. Imagine a network that continuously monitors, optimizes, and upgrades itself all without the need for human intervention. Our audacious journey began in 2018 when we brought together a team of industry veterans and visionaries in networking, cybersecurity, cloud software, and AI to disrupt a $100 billion enterprise networking market, starting with the wired and wireless LAN. Today, our Nile Access Service is redefining connectivity as a service for organizations worldwide, from cutting\-edge technology companies to leading healthcare and financial institutions, and beyond.


**Role Overview:**

The Marketing Operations Manager will be the backbone of our marketing organization—responsible for optimizing processes, managing our tech stack, ensuring data integrity, and enabling the team to execute campaigns that drive measurable growth. Reporting to the organization of the Sr. Director Demand Gen, you’ll collaborate closely with marketing, sales, product, and analytics to ensure our strategies are data\-driven and aligned with business objectives. Ideal candidates should be required to work 4 days onsite.


**Key Responsibilities:**

· **Marketing Systems \& Tools:** Manage, operate, optimize, and integrate our marketing technology stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, Business Intelligence tools, data analytics, Website etc.)


· **Campaign Operations:** Build and manage end\-to\-end campaign workflows, including audience segmentation, lead scoring, and nurturing programs.


· **Analytics \& Reporting:** Develop dashboards and reports to track performance metrics, campaign ROI, and pipeline contribution.


· **Data Management:** Maintain clean, compliant, and enriched marketing data; work with sales ops to ensure CRM alignment.


· **Process Optimization:** Implement best practices to streamline campaign execution, lead routing, and handoff to sales.


· **Budget Tracking:** Assist in managing marketing budgets, vendor relationships, and procurement processes.


· **Cross\-Functional Enablement:** Partner with sales, product, and customer success to ensure marketing efforts align with company objectives.


**Qualifications:**

· Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Technology or related field.


· 6\+ years of “hands\-on” experience in marketing operations, preferably in a B2B SaaS or fast\-growing startup environment. Should have strong administration and operational skills of tech platforms


· Hands\-on experience with marketing automation platforms and CRMs (HubSpot/Marketo \+ Salesforce)


· Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools.


· Proficiency in business intelligence platforms


· Knowledge of attribution modeling, lead lifecycle, and funnel metrics. High degree of proficiency in developing operational workflows, lead to opportunity ownership including lead qualification and nurturing principles


· Detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and highly organized.


· Self\-starter, comfortable in a fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment working across time\-zones collaborating with distributed teams


**Nice\-to\-Haves:**

· Experience with ABM tools (6sense, Demandbase, Terminus).


· Familiarity with SQL or other data querying languages.


· Proficiency in digital operations including SEO and paid campaigns are preferred


· Exposure to growth marketing or performance marketing analytics.


· Excellent communication skills


**Why Join Us?**

· Opportunity to build the marketing operations function from the ground up.


· Work with a smart, collaborative, and mission\-driven team.


· Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.


· Direct impact on company growth and scalability.


· Professional development opportunities


Nile Secure is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in the workplace. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Sr Strategic Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

Grocery \& Retail is a fast\-growing part of Uber Eats, and this role sits at the center of how we identify opportunities, solve problems, and scale the business. We are looking for a Strategic Operations Manager to join our Category Growth organization and drive high\-priority initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
  

  

Depending on the focus area, your work may range from using data to uncover insights and build reporting that informs business decisions, to owning operational programs and cross\-functional initiatives that drive growth and improve the customer and merchant experience.
  

  

You will succeed in this role if you are highly analytical, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and equally willing to develop the strategy and roll up your sleeves to execute it.
  

  

**What You'll Do*** Own high\-priority initiatives end\-to\-end \- define the problem, build a plan, coordinate stakeholders, drive execution, and measure outcomes
* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards \- create trusted views of performance, support recurring business reviews, and help the team understand what is happening and why
* Turn data into insights and action \- analyze performance trends, identify opportunities, and synthesize findings into clear recommendations
* Spot gaps and build solutions \- identify where measurement, process, or operating structure is missing or broken, then help create the framework needed to close it
* Collaborate cross\-functionally \- work across teams including Category, Growth, and Marketing to translate business priorities into action, align stakeholders, and unblock execution

**Basic Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience in analytics, operations, strategy, business intelligence, project management, or a related field
* Strong SQL proficiency \- comfortable writing queries independently to analyze business performance and answer business questions
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications*** Background in grocery, retail, CPG, e\-commerce, marketplaces, or a related industry
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting in tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets for analysis, reporting, and ad hoc work
* Demonstrated ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to own workstreams end\-to\-end and drive execution across stakeholders
* Advanced SQL proficiency and experience working independently with complex datasets
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, automation, and analysis
* Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests and understanding statistical significance
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Tenacious problem\-solver who is comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding a path forward
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Proven ability to balance multiple workstreams and consistently deliver against deadlines in a fast\-paced environment  
* 

  

  

For New York City, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year \- USD $145,000 per year.  

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $131,000 per year \- USD $145,000 per year.  

  

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Revenue
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role:**


We’re looking for a Senior Operations Manager to support our Revenue Growth team for our Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Product. This role will be responsible for quarterly presentations of revenue growth, composed of the diagnosis of any reasons for revenue fluctuation and recommendations for improving topline performance, as well as any ad hoc analysis that is either requested by clients or would improve their overall experience. The Revenue Growth team is critical to customer satisfaction and solvency, and requires cross\-collaboration across our Product, Engineering, Account Management and Operations teams. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact, high\-autonomy role that will quickly expand to cover more and more emergent business problem areas. Successfully navigating and solving our hyper\-growth challenges will lead to rapid growth in role and responsibility.


***This full\-time position requires working five (5\) days a week in our Mountain View, CA office.***

**What You'll Do:**

* Prepare and deliver quarterly presentations on revenue performance, benchmarking against the customer's previous RCM vendor
* Explain revenue deltas by identifying process weaknesses and analyzing shifts in payer and procedure ratios
* Ruthlessly prioritize and implement process fixes to negate drops in revenue
* Craft data\-driven recommendations to help customers enhance efficiency and drive revenue growth
* Launch ad hoc revenue\-generating initiatives across multiple customers
* Continuously drive process improvements for both the internal team and cross\-functional partners

**What You Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field preferred
* 2\-4 years experience in consulting, investment banking or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* Deep experience in data analysis (both SQL and Excel are a must, Python is a bonus) \- basic open\-resource SQL assessment will be part of the interview process
* Proficiency in documenting and developing best practices to enable incremental improvement and optimization of operational processes
* Experience working cross\-functionally with sales, operations and engineering
* Demonstrated drive, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail and a proven record of success
* Novice mentality: You know what you don’t know and you aren’t afraid to ask questions to fill those gaps.
* Comfort in chaos: You’re comfortable working autonomously to solve problems with ambiguity, can expertly prioritize, and have a knack for identifying internal and external blockers.
* Customer obsessed: You’re going to dig until you hit bedrock to solve a problem for the customer, because we need to ensure that our clients have the cash they need to pay the doctors and nurses that work on the front lines of healthcare.
* Proficient in Retool, GSuite is a plus
* Experience in the RCM space is a plus


Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

  

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $160K

ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **Position: Program Manager**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA**


Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEM’s globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales and manufacturing locations globally.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position will be responsible for customer communication, program planning, program budget, and program execution. Manage and provide Technical Leadership for new product development programs with high complexity. Manage these programs to ensure that products/technologies are delivered according to market/customer expectations in respect of specifications, timing and budget.

jobs.title: Solar Project Manager
jobs.description:
***Senior Project Manager*** Commercial Solar, Battery Storage \& Microgrids \| Sausalito, CA (Hybrid)

ABOUT THE COMPANY Our client is a well\-established independent energy consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience serving public agencies across California. Acting as a trusted owner's representative, the firm provides objective technical and project management expertise to help public\-sector clients plan, design, and deploy on\-site energy projects. These include solar, battery storage, EV charging, biogas generation, and in\-line hydro, and they reduce grid energy use and operating expenses.

The result for clients is energy infrastructure that lowers costs, strengthens resiliency through backup power, and advances sustainability goals. The firm is now rebuilding its internal systems to power its next chapter of growth. Its five\-year vision is to become a leaner, more tech\-forward, data\-driven organization and the go\-to energy consultant for public agencies in California.

LOCATION \& TRAVEL **Sausalito, CA. Hybrid schedule: in office Tuesday through Thursday, remote Monday and Friday.**  Travel for site walks and on\-site client meetings, typically one to two visits per month.

POSITION SUMMARY The Senior Project Manager will lead the deployment of commercial\-scale solar, battery storage, and microgrid projects for public\-sector clients throughout California. Serving as the owner's representative, you will guide projects from contract execution through commissioning and keep schedules, budgets, and technical requirements on track.

This role is built for a seasoned project leader who operates independently, thrives in complexity, solves problems proactively, and provides steady leadership to contractors, consultants, and public\-agency stakeholders. Hands\-on experience with the permitting processes and requirements of California electric utilities (PG\&E, SCE, SDG\&E, etc.), the State of California, counties, fire departments, and other AHJs is a must.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES **Lead microgrid projects: Manage advanced microgrid projects in California from contract signing through commissioning.**  Strengthen critical infrastructure: Support water and wastewater utilities in deploying resilient energy solutions that provide backup power and reduce electricity costs. **Work with experienced professionals: Collaborate with a small, highly experienced team with deep expertise in California's energy landscape.**  Make a meaningful impact: Deliver projects that directly support community resilience and long\-term sustainability.

QUALIFICATIONS **Demonstrated project management experience delivering commercial solar and battery storage projects in California.**  Engineering degree or equivalent technical experience. **Strong understanding of California utility rates, tariffs, permitting, and interconnection processes.**  Proven ability to lead contractors and guide public\-agency or institutional clients through complex projects. **Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.**  Self\-motivated, resourceful problem solver focused on communication and results.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE **Engineer holding a professional credential such as PMP, PE, or an equivalent project management or engineering certification.**  Background in project development, project management, or project engineering. **Track record managing commercial\-scale, behind\-the\-meter solar, battery storage, and/or microgrid projects (infrastructure and facilities) for California public agencies, utilities, municipalities, and special districts.**  Strong, clear communicator. **Customer\-centric with a genuine service mentality. Early in each engagement, the role focuses on advising and educating clients so they have the information to make the right decision for their needs. It then shifts to helping them build their projects.**

Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sausalito, CA 94965

You will not only manage timelines and risks but also drive the strategic direction for circular economy initiatives, influencing how our hardware lives on through second and third life cycles.

As a Program Manager for the AI \& Gemini App Marketing team, you will serve as a key operational engine connecting product and marketing strategy to seamless execution. The Senior Project Manager – Aviation leads the successful delivery of airport construction projects — terminal buildings, concourses, and ancillary facilities — through leadership of project teams, client relationships, operational execution, and business performance. This role provides leadership from preconstruction through closeout while mentoring project teams and supporting initiatives that strengthen project delivery across the aviation sector.  

We're looking for someone with real experience building inside an active airport environment — the unique access, security, phasing, and stakeholder coordination that terminal and ancillary building work requires. Experience at any commercial airport is a strong fit; this isn't tied to one specific facility.  

The role reports to the Project Director, Project Executive, Vice President of Operations, or other assigned supervisor, and works closely with clients, consultants, trade partners, field leadership, project teams, and company leadership throughout the project lifecycle.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Champion project safety, quality, scheduling, and risk management across assigned aviation projects, partnering with field leadership on expectations.
* Maintain accountability for project forecasting, budgeting, billing, cash flow, and overall financial performance.
* Lead administration of prime contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, and project agreements, directing compliance and change management processes.
* Evaluate cost impacts, forecast variances, and contractual risks; implement corrective actions and support the resolution of claims or disputes.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, and other project team members.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with airport authorities, consultants, subcontractors, and industry partners, serving as a trusted senior advisor.
* Lead project delivery from preconstruction through closeout — planning, constructability, logistics, procurement, staffing, and execution strategy — with particular attention to the phasing and access constraints of an active airport environment.
* Champion integration of VDC/BIM processes to support constructability, coordination, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee turnover, commissioning, and closeout activities through successful project completion.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 12\+ years of progressively responsible construction industry experience, including terminal or ancillary building work at a commercial airport.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated success managing large or complex construction projects and project teams in active, occupied, or security\-controlled environments.
* Expert understanding of construction contracts, project controls, scheduling, procurement, cost management, and risk management.
* Familiarity with airport authority processes, badging/security requirements, and phased construction in operational facilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction management platforms such as Procore, CMiC, and/or Navisworks.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills, with the ability to build trust across clients, teams, and company leadership.
* OSHA 30\-Hour certification, or ability to obtain within established company timelines.

### **Benefits**

  

* A rare opportunity to lead aviation\-sector work — terminal and ancillary building construction is a specialized niche with real demand and limited competition for talent.
* Real leadership of large, complex projects — shaping delivery strategy from preconstruction through closeout, not just executing someone else's plan.
* 100% employee\-owned (ESOP) company with a track record dating back to 1925 — your work has a direct stake in the outcome.

**Job Overview**

jobs.description:
**POSITION: Program Manager I, Prevention \& Youth**  

**DEPARTMENT: Community Wellness Department (CWD)**  

**REPORTS TO: Senior Program Manager**  

**LOCATION: Native American Health Center, Inc. (NAHC)**  

**WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE**  

**STATUS: Non\-Union, Exempt**

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Community Wellness Department’s program goals include maximizing the quality of the member experience and clinical outcomes. This is achieved through an integrated, team\-oriented, strengths\-based holistic healthcare approach. CWD incorporates prevention, community\-engagement and cultural\-competence, and integration of behavioral health treatment with a particular focus on the local urban Native American community. This approach allows staff and trainees to develop their skills and creates an environment conducive to professional growth and intercultural proficiency.


The Program Manager I (PM I) provides management, support, and implementation of grants within the Community Wellness Department, across multiple sites, and may include supervision of staff members to execute a scope of work. The incumbent plays the primary role in the development and implementation of site programming to ensure attainment of successful internal and grant outcomes including improved community access, system navigation, program sustainability and integration of services. The PM I is responsible for facilitating implementation and delivery of culturally\-based prevention activities and afterschool learning curriculum, including groups, cultural activities, and linkages to traditional knowledge and resources across both NAHC sites and with  

collaborating partners. Additionally, the PM I will be responsible for supervision, leadership, and guidance to the CWD team and oversight of youth engagement and program development. This might also include supervision of volunteers and interns, financial management, event planning, and strategy development.


The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).

1\. **PROGRAM MANAGEMENT**: Responsible for envisioning and facilitating development of a program team, articulating its goals and strategy, and reporting  

on its outputs.  

2\. Work with community and staff to determine unmet community services and program needs. Develop new funding, processes, curriculum, projects and  

approaches in response. Facilitate community advisory councils and use information to inform work.  

3\. Communicate and collaborate with senior stakeholders to integrate and align CWD services across other NAHC departments and ensure compliance with  

department, agency and funding agency regulations.  

4\. Analyze and improve workflow processes for the program.  

5\. Develop annual program work plans in achievement of the program goals and grant deliverables

7\. Adhere to NAHC administrative policy and procedures for check requisitions, travel requisitions, petty cash, etc.  

8\. Coordinate project staff through regular meetings and communications.  

9\. Proactively plan for audits, site visits, and reporting. Review audit agenda and materials, collect necessary documents and collate information in a presentable manner.

11\. Address performance issues with staff in a proactive manner consistent with NAHC policy and procedures. Provide training opportunities and corrective  

actions to improve performance and build staff capacity.  

12\. Ensure meaningful participation by family, youth, and community members in prevention and evaluation processes via design, interpretation, and  

dissemination of findings.  

13\. Represent the program in meetings, task forces, and partner collaborations.  

14\. Work in concert with Research and Evaluation team to ensure that all required data strategies, collection, and documentation of program objectives and  

outcomes occur.  

15\. Assist in creation and implementation of methodologies, process improvements, and evaluation action plans to improve program operations, outcomes, and quality.  

16\. Work in concert with the Communications Team to ensure the social media and outreach strategy objectives are met. Develop compelling campaigns to further expand and promote services and visibility.

jobs.description:
The Youth Ministry Project Coordinator for parishes provides leadership for the implementation of the Salesian Design–Serve–Reflect Initiative across the nine Salesian parishes of the USA West Province. This position strengthens parish youth ministry by accompanying parish leaders, mentoring youth, developing adult companions, coordinating service opportunities, and ensuring consistent implementation of the Province’s youth ministry framework.



This position works closely with parish staff, volunteers, and provincial leadership to support young people (ages 14–30\) in becoming missionary disciples through leadership, service, theological reflection, and active participation in parish life. The position also develops resources, evaluates outcomes, and helps build a sustainable and replicable model of youth ministry throughout the Province.



Work with Youth Ministry Delegate to assist in the coordination of pastors, associate pastors, and lay members at parishes. Support the coordinator of parishes to:


* Ensure the development, implementation, and evaluation of the Standards and Benchmarks of the Salesian Parish.
* Fostering communication and collaboration amongst the different parishes of the Province (emphasizing best practices).
* Supporting the ongoing formation of Salesians and laity who share responsibility for parish ministry, through meetings and moments of formation.
* Supports the Provincial Commission for Parishes and assists with province\-wide parish coordination.
* Serves as the primary administrative support for parish youth ministry initiatives.
* Assists with additional Province Youth Ministry initiatives as responsibilities expand.


***This position is funded through a one\-year grant, with renewal expected based on funding availability and program success.***



Add additional responsibilities under Youth Ministry as this position expands; they will take on other responsibilities, including formation, vocation, and other projects as they arise under the Youth Ministry Department.


**Requirements**
----------------


Mission \& Salesian Formation


* Demonstrates commitment to the mission and values of the Salesians of Don Bosco
* Understanding of Salesian spirituality and the Preventive System
* Ability to facilitate theological reflection


Leadership \& Relationship Building


* Excellent public speaking and facilitation skills
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities
* Experience coaching volunteers and ministry leaders
* Youth leadership development


Program \& Project Management


* Planning and project management experience
* Event planning and logistics coordination
* Budget management
* Data collection and program evaluation


Communication \& Technical Skills


* Strong written communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
* Ability to travel extensively
* Ability to work evenings and weekends as needed
* Bilingual English/Spanish required


Administrative \& Organizational Skills


* Excellent organizational skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to prepare reports and presentations.
* Database management.
* Calendar management.
* Meeting coordination.
* Event logistics.
* Strong collaboration and service skills.
* Confidentiality and discretion.


Wage Range

We consider a number of factors when making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience, training and other department needs.*

**Company Description**  

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world\-renowned care begins with world\-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family\-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state\-of\-the\-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team \- like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  

  

**Job ID:** P146452\-3300

 **Job Description** **JOB SUMMARY**


This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.


The Assistant Patient Care Manager is responsible for assisting the Patient Care Manager with clinical management and administrative coordination of a designated patient care unit(s) or service(s). The position supports the Patient Care Manager in promoting the achievement of the unit(s)' goals and objectives. This position works in a supportive manner as a resource for the patient care unit(s) and as a representative for the Patient Care Manager. Typically assigned responsibility for supervising patient care staff and operations for an assigned shift for a patient care unit(s) and/or for coordinating one or more administrative functions as assigned by the Patient Care Manager, ensuring consistent implementation and monitoring of organizational policies and standards of care, their work involves a combination of clinical (patient care) and administrative responsibilities. The Assistant Patient Care Manager provides consistent and timely information and feedback to the Patient Care Manager and is responsible for knowledge and application of all personnel policies and requirements of the collective bargaining agreements. Assistant Patient Care Managers differ from Patient Care Managers in that the latter are unit managers with total responsibility and accountability for one or more patient care units or services.

jobs.title: Curriculum & Fellowship Program Manager
jobs.description:
Involves designing, conducting, promoting, evaluating and supporting health professions education programs in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements. Supports learners (including but not limited to faculty, residents, clinical fellows, graduate or undergraduate learners, practicing or licensed professionals) in areas such as curriculum, teaching and learning activities, scheduling, core competencies, assessment and evaluations. Coordinates all activities associated with ongoing administration of health professions education programs.


Applies acquired skills, process, and policy knowledge to support professional health education program learners. Coordinates program operations, which include teaching and learning activities, program curriculum, learner scheduling, maintaining databases, tracking learner compliance, and program accreditation.


The Program Analyst for the Resident and Medical Student Education Office works under supervision of the Administrative Director and is responsible for the management and preparation new hire paperwork, appointment, and separation processes for all departmental residents, ACGME fellows and non\-ACGME fellows (appointed through the GME Office) at all sites (Parnassus/Mt. Zion, SFGH, SFVAMC, Kaiser and CPMC); maintenance of the MedHub and ACGME WebADS systems, ACGME Faculty and Resident surveys, and National GME Census; management of complex HR functions (FMLA/leave of absences and visa applications and renewals); support of payroll processing for all residents and fellows; support of event planning/coordination; other duties as assigned.


**Department Overview**

The Department of Surgery is a large clinical department comprised of eight divisions and over 500 employees (Campus and Medical Center staff, faculty, academic research staff, residents, clinical and post doctoral fellows). The Department, through its faculty and staff, conducts teaching, performs research, provides patient care services and performs service to the community. At the center of the educational mission are the trainee residency and fellowship programs. The Department of Surgery has 2 residency and 10 fellowship programs. Many of our trainees go on to become national leaders in research, clinical care or education.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Minimum 3 years related experience.
* Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. Solid knowledge of medical education program requirements. Thorough knowledge of medical education industry.
* Thorough knowledge of administrative analysis and operations research. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement processes and systems. Thorough knowledge of the administrative and operational implications in a program.
* Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; includes active listening and critical thinking.
* Strong interpersonal skills. Actively cooperates and supports the work of others. Ability to work productively with anyone regardless of background. Empathetic and aware of impact on others. Strong problem solving skills to resolve issues.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical, and demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to complete work and meet established deadlines in an accurate and timely manner, and to manage short and competing deadlines.
* Thorough knowledge of data management, documentation methods used in investigating and presenting findings about the program. Skills include statistical analysis of data across databases and systems.

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Liaison (Temporary, Remote)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------


At Sprinter Health, our mission is to dramatically expand access to healthcare by reimagining the patient experience—delivered at home and powered by technology for scale.


We’re building the technology and clinical services platform to make preventive, connected healthcare accessible for everyone in the US. We deliver hybrid care (in\-home \+ virtual) backed by data products across 15\+ states, serving 60%\+ of the US population through major health plans and systems. With 1M\+ patients and 92\+ NPS, we’re rapidly scaling our impact. Our team of technologists, clinicians, and operators is backed by investors including a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel.


We have a rapidly growing team of visionary leaders who are passionate about increasing access to care, lowering healthcare costs, and improving outcomes for patients.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------


We are growing rapidly and are looking for a Clinical Operations Liaison to support our clinical leaders as we scale our field operations and clinical teams. You’ll be the connective thread between our NPs and Sprinters (our clinician field staff) and the operational systems that keep them paid, trained, and compliant — handling workforce tracking, payroll compliance follow\-up, documentation review, and reporting so clinical leadership can stay focused on patient care, clinical support, and clinical oversight.


We’re not just looking for someone to execute a checklist. As we scale, we want someone who notices where a workflow is clunky, a tracker is out of date, or a process could run smoother — and speaks up about it. You’ll have real opportunities to help shape how these processes evolve.


This is a **remote full\-time temporary position**. This role reports to the Director of Quality \& Training.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

### **Workforce \& Payroll Compliance**

* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for NPs and Sprinters on timesheet, mileage, and documentation questions
* Follow up with field employees on timesheet submissions, PTO entries and approval, and sick time to ensure accuracy before each payroll close
* Validate weekly mileage and hours are submitted in accordance with policy and protocols
* Review and abstract supporting documentation for mileage and time submissions
* Approve expenses within set parameters
* Data pulls and tracking for peer audits, bonus incentives
* Deliver a weekly exception report to each manager — escalations only, with full documentation
* Other duties as assigned

### **Workforce Operations \& Reporting**

* Maintain clinical employee attendance, call\-off, and workforce planning trackers
* Track training completion in Sprinter University and annual compliance for clinical teams
* Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports for your assigned clinical area
* Support logistical planning for workforce
* Maintain dashboards, trackers, and workforce metrics
* Other duties as assigned

### **Escalation \& Program Support**

* Manage administrative escalation trackers and ensure timely follow\-up on open items
* Route non\-clinical operational issues to appropriate teams
* Maintain SOPs, workflows, and operational documentation
* Track project milestones and action items; support new workflow launches as directed by the In\-Home Director

### **Compliance \& Quality**

* Participate in internal audits; identify documentation gaps and recommend process improvements
* Flag recurring issues or inefficiencies in existing workflows and propose fixes to your manager
* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and compliance standards

**YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF**
---------------------------

* You take pride in accuracy and integrity, finding satisfaction in getting every detail right
* You’re motivated by mission as much as metrics — knowing your work directly supports better access to preventive and chronic care for patients nationwide
* You thrive in a tech\-forward, fast\-growing environment where innovation and continuous improvement are part of the daily rhythm
* You enjoy working independently in a remote setting while staying connected to a collaborative, purpose\-driven team
* You’re naturally curious, proactive, and eager to contribute feedback and shape evolving processes
* Most of all, you value flexibility, accountability, and being part of a company that’s reimagining how healthcare reaches people where they are

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------


You will thrive at Sprinter Health if you have:

* A desire to work collaboratively with a tight\-knit but quickly growing team across many different areas of the business
* Flexibility, humility, and a sense of humor
* Excitement for working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment

**Experience and Skills:**

* 2\+ years in an operations, coordination, or administrative support role
* Experience managing multiple workflows, trackers, or reports simultaneously
* 2\+ years of demonstrated success identifying and implementing AI\-driven solutions to optimized workflows and improve operational success
* Comfortable working independently and remotely with minimal day\-to\-day direction
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Proficient in EHR systems and Google tools
* Reliable internet connection and dedicated, secure workspace
* Available to work CST or PST hours

**Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare operations, medical group administration, or home health/home care
* Familiarity with multi\-state payroll or leave compliance
* Experience supporting a distributed or regional field team
* Prior use of Rippling or a similar HRIS platform

**THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE**
------------------------------

* Disciplinary action or performance management
* Clinical, patient\-facing, or care coordination responsibilities

**TECHNOLOGIES WE USE**
-----------------------

* Slack
* Google Suite (Docs, Slides, Sheets)
* Rippling or similar HRIS platform

The Patient Access Services job is responsible for completing patient admissions and registration functions. Identifies patients' insurance coverage or existing financial resources to pay for medical care and services. Handles routine customer service inquiries and concerns. Processes necessary admission/registration paperwork and obtains necessary documents for billing and compliance requirements. The PAR I position is intended as an entry\-level position for individuals with limited background in patient admitting/registration, recent graduates from trade schools and training programs, and/or experience in non\-healthcare with customer service background. It is expected that individuals on this level will acquire the necessary job skills, knowledge, and other qualifications through on\-the\-job and/or formal training to advance to the Patient Access Representative level II with a minimum of 1\-year experience within Patient Access Services.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care

* Assures secure handling and accurate recording of payments collected at the point\-of\-service delivery.
* Builds a foundational understanding of the different health insurance coverage options and the related processes and procedures.
* Able to handle routine/simple patient escalations and perform service recovery.
* Escalates any advanced or complex registrations to a more experienced team member.

Maintains professional communication with various PAS staff, clinical staff, physicians, guests, and patients regarding the admitting/registration services rendered at Stanford Health Care \- ValleyCare. Communication may consist of telephone correspondence, email, or in person contact.

High School Diploma or GED  

*

One (1\) year of progressively responsible and directly related work experience. Required
