------------

***To qualify for US internships, you must be currently enrolled in a degree\-seeking program with an expected graduation date after the internship/co\-op ends. If you do not meet this requirement, we invite you to explore other opportunities available on our careers website.***  

Intuit internships are 12 weeks throughout the summer. We have fixed start and end dates that are designed to work with various universities’ academic calendars.* ***Cohort 1: Monday, May 17 \- Friday, August 6, 2027 (12 weeks)***
* ***Cohort 2: Monday, June 14 \- Friday September 3, 2027 (12 weeks)***

 **About our Emerging Talent Program:**


Intuit invests in Emerging Talent because fresh perspectives strengthen our products and teams. The program is backed by a culture that values curiosity and collaboration, and you'll be supported by dedicated managers and mentors who are invested in your growth. As an intern or co\-op, you'll work on meaningful projects with business impact, many centered on AI and emerging technologies, and contribute to driving decisions. You'll build skills through function\-specific learning opportunities, connect with a global community of interns and co\-ops through dedicated programming and social events, and get exposure to senior leadership and cross\-functional work across Intuit's product ecosystem. Learn more about our Intern and Co\-op Program here. **About the Team**  

At Intuit, we believe in the power of early talent. Our internship and co\-op program provides hands\-on experience, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to real\-world projects that impact millions. We get up every morning with our hearts beating fast, driven by the knowledge that we're transforming the world of consumer and small business finance. It's why our products continue to resonate with 50 million consumers around the globe. SMB and Business Platform is home to QuickBooks, the core product for tens of millions of small businesses worldwide. Within this organization, the SMB Business Operations (BizOps) team sits embedded with each product VP, from QBO Core to IAS/Accountants, Omni, Customer Growth, and Commercial, turning ambiguous business problems into decisions leadership can act on. Join us as a Product Strategy and Business Operations MBA Intern. You will rotate across BizOps pods to get broad exposure to how a platform business this size actually runs strategy and operations, not a single narrow project, but the full range of problems a BizOps team owns: product and roadmap prioritization, market and competitive assessment, executive communication, KPI definition, and the connective work between product, marketing, and finance. This role is a strong fit for candidates with a management consulting background, or MBAs using the summer to test consulting as a post\-MBA path. The work mirrors a consulting engagement: a defined problem, a data\-backed recommendation, and a stakeholder who acts on it, but built inside an operating business rather than delivered to a client. **Responsibilities**


 Partner with BizOps leads and product VPs across two or more pods (QBO Core, IAS/Accountants, Omni, Customer Growth, Commercial) to get hands\-on exposure to how product strategy and operations differ by business context.* Take on a defined product strategy project with a named business owner and a measurable outcome, for example a market sizing analysis, a

build/buy/partner assessment, a roadmap prioritization framework, or a competitive assessment that leadership will act on.* Translate customer and market signal into roadmap trade\-offs, working directly with product leaders on what to prioritize and why.
* Support the synthesis of qualitative and quantitative input into a clear point of view, not a summary of options.
* Build and refine

executive\-ready materials (strategy memos, business reviews) that name the problem before the recommendation.* Sit in on pod operating rhythms (staff meetings, business reviews) to see how decisions actually get made and tracked.
* Present findings and a recommendation directly to VP\-level stakeholders at the end of the rotation.

 **Qualifications**

* Currently enrolled in an MBA program, with a graduation date after the internship end date.
* Prior work experience (2\+ years) before business school. Management consulting background strongly preferred; strategy, operations, or high\-growth startup experience also considered.
* Strong analytical ability. Comfortable moving from a messy business question to a structured hypothesis to a data\-backed recommendation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Able to state a point of view clearly, not just lay out options.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to self\-direct across multiple stakeholders with limited day\-to\-day oversight.
* Highly skilled with AI tools, agents, and automation, with an instinct for where they can remove manual work from a process critical to running the business, not just personal productivity use cases.
* Ability to work onsite for a minimum of 3 days per week. Nice to Haves: • Small Business B2B, SaaS, or fintech experience.
* Case interview or client\-facing engagement experience.
* Experience shipping or piloting an AI agent or automation that changed how a team actually worked.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Growth)
jobs.description:
**About Veritus**
-----------------


Veritus Agent is building the first fully AI\-native voice agent platform for consumer lending and collections. We're a YC\-backed team with leadership from Best Egg, PayPal, Divvy, and Lending Club—on a mission to modernize legacy call centers with real\-time AI agents that drive higher conversions, lower costs, and better borrower outcomes.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll be the main point of contact for a book of our Growth customers — collection agencies, lenders and fintechs — from kickoff through go\-live, renewal and expansion.


Internally, you're the bridge to our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who build and tune each customer's agents. You turn customer asks into clear requests for the team, and turn build updates back into plain language for the customer.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the customer relationship**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a book of Growth accounts, with a prescriptive and consultative approach
* Run regular check\-ins: agent performance, what shipped, what's blocked and what the customer owes us
* Send clear recaps after every call so decisions and next steps are never ambiguous
* Communicate with every level of the customer's team, from collections floor managers and IT leads to owners and C\-level executives

**Get agents live and performing**

* Guide customers through their deployment journey, from kickoff and scoping to go\-live, adoption and measurable results
* Chase the inputs a launch depends on — scripts, compliance sign\-off, data files, phone numbers, integration access — without letting timelines drift
* Monitor account health signals (using customer metrics) and step in early when something slips
* Translate build updates, trade\-offs and timelines back to customers in plain language
* Relay customer insights to our engineering team so what we learn in one account improves every agent

**Grow the book**

* Drive pilot\-to\-annual conversions and renewals across your accounts
* Spot and qualify expansion: new channels, a second agent, a new portfolio or client of the customer
* Help build our scaled Growth motion — onboarding templates, email cadences and self\-serve materials that let one CSM run many accounts well

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role at a tech company (customer success, account management, implementation or support) **or** in lending or collections operations (at a lender, servicer, agency or fintech)
* Hands\-on experience rolling out automation, AI or contact\-center technology to an operations team — and judging whether it's actually working
* Excellent written communication: your recaps, emails and tickets are short, specific and impossible to misread
* Excellent verbal communication: you can run a call with an agency owner, simplify a technical concept for a non\-technical customer, and hold a firm position politely
* Maturity and sound judgment: you own mistakes, deliver bad news early, and flag problems before the customer notices them
* Comfort managing many accounts and moving parts at once, with a structured way to prioritize what matters today
* A data\-driven approach to spotting risk early, and comfort in spreadsheets and a CRM
* Collaborative, empathetic and low\-ego; you like working closely with engineers

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Working knowledge of collections: delinquency stages, settlements and payment plans, first\- vs third\-party collections
* Familiarity with collections compliance (FDCPA, Reg F, TCPA) or regulated consumer\-finance workflows
* Experience with AI agents, conversational AI or contact\-center software
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot, Linear or similar CRM and ticketing tools
* Experience at an early\-stage startup

**Location and compensation**
-----------------------------

* **Location:** San Francisco (hybrid in\-office)
* **Base salary:** $120,000–$180,000 depending on experience
* **Equity:** meaningful early\-stage equity
* **Benefits:** health, dental, vision, 401(k), other perks

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU?**



Box is redefining how enterprises manage and unlock value from their content in an AI\-first world. In this role, you will partner with enterprise customers not only to adopt Box, but to transform how work gets done across their organization using content and AI.



You will serve as a strategic advisor and operator, helping customers understand their current content workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and design future\-state solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.



You will work closely with executive stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to align on priorities, drive change management, and ensure that Box delivers tangible impact. This role represents the evolution of Customer Success at Box—from driving adoption to driving transformation. The ideal candidate combines customer success, consulting, and solution\-oriented thinking—someone who is curious about how businesses operate, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by driving real outcomes.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the post\-sales relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes and long\-term value realization
* Partner with customers to map and redesign critical workflows
* + Identify and activate AI\-powered use cases within these workflows
* Translate customer goals into a clear value hypothesis, success metrics and practical AI solutions
* Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of new workflows and behaviors, including stakeholder alignment, enablement and executive engagement
* Conduct strategic adoption business reviews that focus on outcomes, ROI and future opportunities
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities within accounts, using both qualitative insight and data to guide action
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering and Professional Services to:
* + Expand Box's footprint within the customer
	+ Influence product direction based on real\-world use cases
	+ Deliver cohesive, high\-impact solutions
* Serve as the voice of the customer, bringing structured insights on workflows, pain points and AI opportunities back to internal team

**WHO YOU ARE**



We are an AI\-first company. You approach your work with a growth mindset and actively look for ways to leverage AI to drive smarter decisions, unlock new use cases, and increase your impact


* 4\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer\-facing managing a book of business
* Experience working with enterprise customers and engaging with senior stakeholders and executives
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into practical solutions and business outcomes
* Strong ability to navigate technical and business conversations, including discussing integrations, systems, and data flows at a high level
* Solid hands\-on experience with modern AI platforms and tools, with enough technical depth to understand, evaluate, and challenge solutions without needing to write production code
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate value clearly and persuasively
* Highly proactive, self\-directed and team player who brings fresh ideas for user adoption, churn mitigation and expansion
* Demonstrated ability to share expertise, develop best practices and contribute to the broader success of the team

Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
**About Roger**  

Roger is an AI platform that frees home health clinicians from paperwork so they can focus on what matters: delivering life\-changing care to our most vulnerable elderly patients in the comfort of their homes. Backed by leading healthcare investors like SignalFire, we've powered millions of visits, deployed to thousands of clinicians, and we're just getting started.

**Job Overview**  

We are looking for Business Operations team members to join our early team. This is a role for a sharp, scrappy operator who wants to learn the business by working in it. Depending on company needs, you will be placed in one area of the business, such as customer operations, revenue operations, people operations, or hiring, and own it end to end.


You will work directly with founders and team leads, and there may be opportunities to take on work in other areas over time as the company grows. This is not a narrow role with a rigid playbook. You will figure things out, build systems, and take real ownership of your area.


You need to be genuinely curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by the idea that no problem is "not your job."

**What You Might Work On**  

Your focus will shift as the company grows. You may dive into any of these areas:

* **Hiring:** Step in as an interim hiring manager, run interview loops, track the data, and manage agency and recruiter relationships.
* **People Ops:** Own employee onboarding, support HR processes, and help build the systems that keep a growing team running smoothly.
* **Revenue Operations:** Manage our sales tools, clean and maintain CRM data, and set up workflows and automations that make the GTM team faster.
* **Customer and Support Operations:** Partner with our success and support teams on scheduling, tracking, and process improvements, and help investigate customer issues across teams.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Work with engineering, finance, and leadership to unblock projects and keep things moving.
* **Special Projects:** Build dashboards and metrics for the C\-suite, run analyses, and take on whatever high\-priority project comes up next.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Take projects from ambiguous idea to finished result with minimal oversight.
* **Operational Execution:** Keep the details straight: follow\-ups, record\-keeping, and coordination so nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Systems Building:** Spot broken or manual processes and replace them with clean, scalable workflows.
* **Data and Insights:** Build dashboards, track key metrics, and surface insights that help leadership make better decisions.
* **Cross\-Team Partnership:** Work closely with founders and team leads, and be the person people rely on to get things done.
* **Fast Learning:** Quickly pick up new tools, domains, and workflows, including how home health works and where Roger fits into it.

**Requirements:**

* **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional experience, with prior startup experience required. Backgrounds in operations, RevOps, BizOps, customer success, or similar roles are a strong fit.
* **Fast Learner:** Picks up unfamiliar domains, tools, and processes quickly. Healthcare exposure is a plus but not required.
* **Detail Oriented:** Catches the small things others miss, keeps clean records, and takes pride in precision.
* **Strong Communicator:** Clear, warm, and professional with teammates, candidates, customers, and leadership.
* **Data Comfortable:** Able to work in dashboards, CRMs, and spreadsheets, and use data to spot opportunities.
* **Startup Generalist:** Comfortable with ambiguity, motivated by mission, and energized by ownership in a fast\-paced environment. Eager to jump into any part of the business and execute well.

**Why Join Us?**  

Platinum health, dental, and vision insurance  

Unlimited PTO  

Retirement: 401(k) plan  

Unmatched career growth as an early hire, with exposure to every part of the business  

Work on a mission that matters, backed by AI innovation and top\-tier investors

**Make a Real Difference \- Hear from our Users:**  

"If I had to give Roger a rating out of 10, I'd give it an 11! You guys changed my life!!" \- G.M. from San Francisco, Registered Nurse  

"Roger AI saves me hours per day. I can easily focus on my patients now too." \- J.L. from Tucson, Registered Nurse  

"Being a single mom is tough, but with Roger I can take the time to go to my daughter's soccer game and also pursue further education." \- T.M. from Dallas, Licensed Vocational Nurse


Compensation Range: $110K \- $160K

jobs.title: Lead Care Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US
Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex\-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and paramedical homecare functions funded through IHSS. Our work allows an often\-underserved population to live safely in their community. Homebridge offers a dynamic, fast\-paced work environment with 350\+ unionized field workers and 90\+ internal office staff.  

POSITION SUMMARY
The Lead Care Manager oversees the delivery of Enhanced Care Management services for Medi‑Cal members with complex medical, behavioral, and social needs. This role provides clinical oversight, supports care managers, ensures fidelity to CalAIM ECM requirements, and maintains high‑quality, person‑centered care coordination across medical, behavioral health, community, and social service systems.  

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS* Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients' health, social, and environmental needs to develop personalized care plans.
* Support clients in engaging in the Enhanced Care Management seven core services, including outreach and engagement, comprehensive assessment/care management planning, enhanced care coordination, health promotion, comprehensive transitional care, individual and family supports, and referrals to community/social supports.
* Coordinate with healthcare providers, social services, and other community resources to ensure clients receive holistic and continuous care.
* Regularly monitor clients' progress, adjusting care plans as necessary, and conduct follow\-up visits or calls to ensure they are adhering to their care plans.
* Advocate on behalf of clients to secure necessary services and support, ensuring their needs and preferences are met.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of client interactions, care plans, and progress reports, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Educate clients and their families about their health conditions, treatment options, and available resources to empower them to make informed decisions.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to ensure integrated and coordinated care, participating in case conferences and team meetings as needed.
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES* Ability to understand and use computer applications, including spreadsheets and electronic health records; including internet access and email.
* Ability to understand the needs of clients from different cultures and socioeconomic backgrounds.
* Awareness of community resources and services.
* Effective organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to solve problems and be proactive.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with coworkers, clients and members of the community.
* Ability to travel within the service area.
  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE* Two (2\) years of experience in Mental Health or community services; or Bachelor's degree in Social Services or related field.
* Experience working in case or care management, preferably with a background in healthcare or social services.
  

WORK ENVIRONMENT
This position will have in the field and office work environments which includes frequent travel \- must be able to travel on foot or via public transportation to all parts of San Francisco County for performance of job duties. May occasionally be exposed to outside weather conditions while traveling to clients. Some exposure to physical risk. Exposure to client apartments, rooms, homes and other venues so that services can be provided, client homes may have pets/pet dander and/or cigarette smoke. May include contact with clients with mental health and/or personal hygiene issues.  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for extended periods of time at a desk or computer workstation. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. *Homebridge Is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Patient Care Coordinator** **Berkeley Hearing Center \- Berkeley, CA** **Full\-time, In\-Person**

**About Berkeley Hearing Center**

Berkeley Hearing Center has been the audiologist\-led home for premium hearing healthcare in the East Bay for more than seven decades. We don't dispense hearing aids. We build long\-term clinical relationships, guided by our Berkeley Hearing Method (Understand, Build, Adapt, Protect), and powered by a team that genuinely believes care should never be compromised.

This is a practice built on depth, not volume. Our patients are educated, discerning, and often navigating one of the more significant health decisions of their lives. They deserve a front\-line experience that honors that.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join a well\-staffed, well\-supported front\-office team. This is a full clinical\-support role, not a reception position. You will be the first voice a new patient hears, the last person they interact with after an appointment, and a consistent presence in a care relationship that may span years.

While it may feel like a routine appointment to our schedule, it is a significant moment for the person walking through the door. Your job is to make sure they feel that difference every single time.

**Who You Are**

Experience matters. But character matters more. If your friends and coworkers would describe you like this, we want to meet you:

* Always warm, positive, and genuinely enjoyable to be around
* Friendly and approachable from the very first hello, including over the phone
* Patient, calm, and compassionate, especially with older adults
* A team player who pitches in without being asked and puts the team before ego
* Detailled and acurate: you double\-check your work and rarely make mistakes
* Takes ownership: gives credit, takes initiative and responsibility, and solves problems
* Comfortable multi\-tasking and confident under pressure
* Coachable and open to feedback, always looking to improve
* Reliable and consistent: here, on time, and prepared

That's not just who we're looking for. It's also who you'll be working alongside.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Answer inbound calls and schedule appointments with empathy and clinical awareness, guiding patients through a process that can feel unfamiliar or daunting
* Manage provider schedules to balance new\-patient access with continuity of care for returning patients
* Prepare audiologists for appointments with complete, accurate notes and relevant patient history
* Welcome patients in a way that reflects the quality of care they are about to receive
* Coordinate hearing technology orders, repairs, and manufacturer communications
* Handle patient check\-out, payment collection, and financial policy communication with clarity and confidence

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong interpersonal skills, particularly with older adults and their families
* Detail\-oriented with a genuine understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality
* Technologically confident: VoIP phones, online scheduling, digital fax queues, and a willingness to learn new systems
* A clear, confident communicator in writing and in person
* Someone who helps patients understand the value of treatment through honest, educational conversation
* Spanish fluency is a meaningful advantage in our patient community
* Healthcare or audiology front\-office experience is a plus, but we hire for the person first

**What You Get**

* $25\-28/hour base pay
* Health and dental coverage after 60 days
* Team\-based bonus opportunities tied to practice performance
* Profit\-sharing 401(k) after one year
* Real growth potential as the practice expands
* A team that is genuinely glad you're here

**How to Apply**

Send us your resume and a brief note explaining why this role is the right fit for you.

One more thing: this posting contains exactly two spelling errors. Point them out. It tells us something important about how you work.

We look forward to meeting you.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Profit sharing

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
At Medrio, our purpose is to save 1,000,000 lives by providing clinical researchers with the software tools necessary to chase the next breakthrough in public health. Our success is defined by our customers' ability to accelerate their research, eliminate hurdles, and maximize their return on investment. We're committed to supporting our customers (primarily sponsors and CROs in early phase pharma, medical device, and diagnostic clinical research) along their journey of medical discovery.



Medrio is looking for an enthusiastic and talented individual with a passion for providing a positive customer experience. Our team is focused on results and maintains a high customer satisfaction rating. The role of the Technical Support Representative is to help maintain and bolster customer happiness. This entry\-level position will enable you to learn best practices in customer service, operations, gain expert\-level product and industry knowledge, interact with all internal teams and get in on the ground floor with a growing company. Medrio's strong commitment to customer success will provide you with a unique opportunity to become an integral part of Medrio's continued growth.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Receiving, responding to, tracking and directing technical support calls and e\-mails from our customers
* Managing support case details in case tracking system
* Prioritize incoming cases in a high\-volume, fast\-paced environment
* Acting as support for the sales team, including study management and various marketing tasks
* Various tasks for QA support
* Other duties as assigned


Key Metrics for a Technical Support Representative (Measured Quarterly):


* Customer Satisfaction Score (over 90%)
* First Contact Resolution (Over 25% of cases)
* Case Resolved in 1 Business Day (70% of cases)
* Case Resolved in 3 Business Days (93%)
* Average workload of approximately 7\-10 Technical Support cases/day


First 30/60/90 Days


* First month is on\-boarding, and beginning to take administrative\-level tickets to learn workflows and systems
* Second month we are working in more difficult tickets and answering the phone
* At the end of 60 days, on\-boarding is complete, and are being evaluated against Key Metrics
* By the end of 90 days, TSR is considered fully ramped and beginning to take on other duties as assigned.


Skills/Areas of Experience:


* Flexibility to work schedule aligned with Asia Pacific region when required
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Experience with phone and e\-mail support
* Excellent communications skills, both written and oral
* Experience giving presentations, training, or related activity
* Experience with Salesforce, SaaS technology, software support


Salary range: $58,000 \- $67,000


**About Medrio:**



At Medrio, we look for smart, capable, and conscientious people to help us expand our product capabilities, grow our business, and better serve our customers. Our employees love working for us because they get to develop, market, and sell a product that advances human health, and they enjoy many perks, including


* Great benefits: We offer medical, dental, vision, and life/LTD insurance, and we cover 100% of our employees' health insurance premiums and 50% of dependent premiums.
* Wellness: Medrio values our staff's well\-being. To prove it, we promote an atmosphere of work/life balance, including flexible work schedules and locations.
* Weekly company\-wide standup.


The Medrio team is made up of individuals with a wide array of skills and interests, but all have a passion for providing the best possible user experience for our customers. We value collaboration, ingenuity and creating a culture of excellence!

**Job Description:**

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

 **About the role**


Crowe’s Metals \& Materials Consulting practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Consultant** to help shape the future of our D365 practice. This role offers the opportunity to lead solution architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and work directly with finance and operations leaders across manufacturing and distribution organizations.

  

If you want meaningful impact, autonomy, and a clear path to practice leadership, this is a strategic career opportunity—not just another consulting role.

* Engage in team\-building and internal initiatives, leveraging non\-client time for personal development and practice enhancement.

 **What Makes Crowe a Strong Career Move**

* **High\-impact role** with direct influence on solution strategy and client outcomes.
* **Rapidly growing D365 Finance practice** backed by a nationally recognized consulting brand.
* **Clear advancement path** into Solution Architect, Industry Lead, or Practice Leadership roles.
* **Strong investment in your development** (certification support, training, conferences, thought leadership opportunities).
* **Collaborative culture** that values quality, innovation, and balanced workloads.
* **Flexible work environment** with predictable, project\-based travel (25%–50%).

 **Experience That Makes You Successful (Must\-Have)**

* Bachelors degree required.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on D365 Finance implementation leadership or equivalent ERP delivery experience.
* Proven track record delivering complex, full\-lifecycle D365 Finance projects.
* Strong functional expertise across core finance and operational modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash/Bank, Reporting, etc.).
* Ability to lead solution architecture, translate requirements into actionable designs, and guide teams through execution.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, produce high\-quality work products, and lead engagements with minimal oversight.

 **Preferred**

* Experience in Manufacturing or Distribution environments; Metals industry exposure highly valued.
* Strong functional expertise across operational modules (Procurement, Inventory, etc.).
* Experience with complementary ISV solutions within the D365 ecosystem.
* D365 certifications in Finance or related modules; CPA, CMA, or CFA a plus.
* Prior consulting experience within a professional services environment.

* Opportunity to shape the direction of the D365 practice.
* Access to diverse and challenging client environments.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Care Operations Platform
jobs.description:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical\-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value\-based\-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality\-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50\+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48\-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi\-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short\-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution\-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost\-per\-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under\-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well\-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross\-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

**Adoption.** Shipping is half the job. You own whether features are actually used: rollout plans, in\-product guidance, enablement materials and documentation, adoption targets per release, and follow\-up on the ones that miss. A feature sitting at 11% adoption is an open problem, not a completed ticket.

**Practices.** Help raise how the whole product function works — brief and spec templates, definition of ready and done, the decision log, the metrics review. We're building the PM layer close to from scratch, and you'll leave real fingerprints on it.

What we're looking for

**Required**

* 3–5 years as a product manager, **including healthcare product experience** — clinical workflow, care management, population health, digital health, RCM, or an equivalent regulated clinical domain
* Hands\-on experience owning **integrations with third\-party systems** — EHRs, clearinghouses, device or telephony vendors, data partners — and a clear point of view on what makes an integration feel seamless to the user and observable to the team running it
* A track record of shipping: features that reached production and changed a number you can name
* Experience with workflow\-heavy products used by demanding daily users under time pressure
* Strong discovery instincts — you go to where the work happens rather than relying on tickets and secondhand requests
* Fluency with metrics. You can define them, instrument them, question them, and resist the pretty ones that don't drive decisions
* Excellent written communication. We run on written briefs, specs, and decisions across several time zones
* Comfort owning a release process: coordinating QA, managing scope under deadline, and being accountable when it slips
* Enough technical depth to hold a real design discussion with engineers — you don't need to code, but you do need to understand what you're asking for
* Authorized to work in the US

**A strong plus**

* Working knowledge of quality measures and gap closure (HEDIS or similar) — specs, eligibility, evidence, measurement per

jobs.title: Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations (Mandarin, Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
We are hiring a **Mandarin\-speaking Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations** who combines strong U.S. immigration case\-management experience with advanced AI and legal\-technology skills.

This is not a traditional paralegal position.

We are building an AI\-native immigration practice where highly capable case managers use AI and modern case\-management technology to independently manage substantially more of the case lifecycle—from intake and evidence collection through drafting, quality control, and attorney\-ready review.

You do **not** need to be an AI engineer or programmer.

You **do need to be highly fluent with AI and modern business software and already know how to use Claude effectively for sophisticated immigration work.**

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to use Claude beyond basic prompting—for example, working with large case files and long\-context documents, structuring complex immigration analysis, extracting and organizing evidence, identifying inconsistencies and missing information, developing evidence matrices, preparing and improving drafts, analyzing RFEs, performing quality control, and building repeatable AI\-assisted workflows.

You should know how to give AI the right context and instructions, evaluate its output critically, verify it against source documents, identify hallucinations or unsupported conclusions, and iterate until the work product meets a professional standard.

**AI proficiency is a core qualification for this position, not something we expect to teach from the beginning.**

**What You’ll Do**

You will take ownership of immigration cases from assignment through attorney review, including:

* Communicating directly with clients in Mandarin and English
* Reviewing intake information, CVs, immigration records, and supporting documents
* Identifying missing information and proactively following up
* Managing case progress, deadlines, and outstanding items
* Preparing immigration forms and supporting documentation
* Organizing evidence and exhibits
* Assisting with petitions, recommendation letters, RFEs, and other case materials
* Using Claude extensively for document analysis, evidence analysis, drafting, case organization, and quality control
* Using modern case\-management and business software efficiently
* Checking AI\-generated work against the underlying record
* Identifying factual inconsistencies and potential issues
* Escalating matters requiring attorney judgment
* Developing better prompts, templates, checklists, and repeatable workflows
* Delivering organized, substantially complete cases for attorney review

The objective is straightforward:

**Once a case is assigned to you, you should be capable of moving it from intake to attorney\-ready review with minimal attorney intervention.**

**Who We’re Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if you have:

* Professional fluency in **Mandarin Chinese and English**
* Meaningful U.S. immigration case\-management or paralegal experience
* **Advanced proficiency using Claude for professional immigration work**
* Strong general AI literacy and the ability to work effectively with large amounts of information
* High proficiency with modern corporate software, document\-management systems, cloud collaboration tools, and case\-management platforms
* Experience independently managing immigration cases
* Excellent organization and attention to factual detail
* Strong written communication skills
* The ability to manage multiple matters without constant attorney supervision
* The judgment to distinguish routine production issues from matters requiring attorney attention

Experience with employment\-based immigration—including **EB\-1A, EB\-2 NIW, O\-1, H\-1B, L\-1, PERM, I\-140, and I\-485**—is highly valued.

Experience at a sophisticated business immigration practice is a plus, but not required.

**What “AI Proficiency” Means to Us**

We are **not** looking for someone whose AI experience consists primarily of asking ChatGPT or Claude to rewrite emails.

A strong candidate should be comfortable demonstrating how they use Claude to work through an actual immigration matter.

For example, you should be able to take a substantial client file and use AI intelligently to:

* understand and structure the case;
* extract relevant facts from multiple documents;
* identify missing or contradictory information;
* create timelines;
* analyze and categorize evidence;
* build evidence matrices;
* analyze publications and citation records;
* organize EB\-1A/O\-1 evidence by criterion;
* organize NIW evidence around the proposed endeavor;
* analyze an RFE against the existing record;
* prepare customized evidence requests;
* produce first drafts from verified source materials;
* compare drafts against underlying evidence;
* perform consistency and quality\-control reviews;
* and turn successful approaches into reusable workflows.

You should also understand AI’s limitations.

**Fast AI\-generated work that contains unsupported facts, missed evidence, or hallucinations is not good work.**

The person we want knows how to make AI powerful **and** reliable.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most immigration case\-management positions are still structured around traditional production methods.

This one is not.

We want to see what happens when an experienced immigration professional becomes exceptionally effective at combining:

**Immigration knowledge \+ case ownership \+ Claude \+ modern software \+ operational judgment.**

The objective is not simply to draft faster. It is to enable one excellent case manager to perform work that traditionally required substantially more administrative and junior\-production support.

**Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **Senior Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **AI Operations / Case Management Lead**

About ¡WEPA! líbros®

¡WEPA! líbros® partners with schools and public libraries to expand access to authentic books in the languages their communities speak. We design curated collections around each client’s educational goals and source books internationally to bring those collections to life.

About the Role

You will own assigned collection projects from the approved client brief through the handoff to purchasing. You’ll direct and review curation, resolve gaps, track deadlines, and make sure each collection is accurate and ready to order.

We’re looking for someone with strong judgment about multilingual literature who is equally strong at moving work forward. In this remote role, you’ll keep project records current, make decisions within your scope, and communicate early when a deadline or requirement is at risk.

* Turn client goals, age levels, languages, budget, and collection priorities into clear direction for curators.

* Curate titles directly when a project requires it.
* Maintain clear project synopses, status updates, and outstanding decisions.
* Coordinate changes and substitutions with purchasing.
* Deliver complete purchasing handoffs on time, with unresolved issues identified and addressed.
* Communicate directly with clients about collection direction and approvals when assigned.

What You’ll Bring

* Experience in collection development, children’s literature, school or public libraries, curriculum materials, publishing, or a related field.
* A track record of managing detailed projects and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
* The ability to review a collection against a brief and make specific, defensible corrections.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and close attention to book data.
* Clear written communication and good judgment about when to act, collaborate, or escalate.
* Reliable availability and follow\-through in a remote role.

Spanish proficiency is helpful. Experience working with multilingual collections is welcome, but the ability to manage collection quality and project execution is essential.

This is a part\-time W\-2 position with scheduled weekly availability.

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 15\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role***


This specific role provides Social Work support to our Palliative Care Program.


Devoted’s virtual Palliative Care program serves members with complex needs and life\-limiting illness who otherwise would not have access to specialized palliative care. We pride ourselves on providing highly compassionate, patient\-centered goals of care counseling and symptom management for members projected to be in the final year of life. We meet patients where they are and support them in defining quality of life, achieving meaningful goals, and transitioning to hospice care.


As a Palliative Care Social Work Case Manager, you will serve our patients as an advocate, coach, and connector \- working closely with patients, caregivers and other members of the team to identify and eliminate socioeconomic and psychosocial barriers and provide supportive counseling. This role will require you to develop individualized care plans that align community, clinical, and patients’ personal resources.You will provide coaching on improving coping skills, self\-management, and caregiver assistance, re\-enforce disease\-specific education and facilitate goals of care and advanced care planning discussions, including hospice care transitions when appropriate.


Responsibilities will include:

* Telephonic and video visits with patients and caregivers
* Establish trust and build strong relationships with our patients

* Conduct Social Work interventions to maximize the effectiveness of the program


	+ Conduct psychosocial assessments and create personalized care plans tailored to members’ needs
	+ Provide emotional and caregiver support
	+ Assist in navigating complex family/support issues
	+ Complete goals of care conversations and advanced care planning

jobs.description:
**About Sanguine Biosciences, Inc.**


Sanguine Biosciences is accelerating personalized medicine research by empowering patients with their healthcare data and making it as easy as possible for them to participate in the medical research process. We partner with patients and pharmaceutical companies to accelerate precision medicine R\&D by securely and efficiently collecting and providing patient samples and relevant health data. We are helping thousands of researchers at 20 of the top 40 global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies increase the speed and quality at which they are conducting their research. It is an exciting time; our biotech company is growing quickly and needs the best team members to join us.

 **About the Role:**


The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. This role is accountable for oversight and effectiveness of change control, Computer System Validation (CSV), including validation of GxP\-relevant software, AI\-assisted/low\-code/no\-code tools, and native\-built applications, risk management, supplier/vendor quality, deviation/complaint handling, CAPA, internal auditing, and training. The QA Manager partners cross\-functionally to drive a culture of quality, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**


 The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. This role is accountable for oversight and effectiveness of change control, Computer System Validation (CSV), including validation of GxP\-relevant software, AI\-assisted/low\-code/no\-code tools, and native\-built applications, risk management, supplier/vendor quality, deviation/complaint handling, CAPA, internal auditing, and training. The QA Manager partners cross\-functionally to drive a culture of quality, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

  

Leadership \& QMS Governance

* Lead and develop QA staff through coaching, workload prioritization, performance feedback, and training plans.

jobs.title: Patient Access & Eligibility Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist**


 Overview:


The Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist plays a critical role in supporting patient access to care management services by ensuring accurate insurance verification, confirming program eligibility, and assisting patients through administrative intake processes.


This role serves as the front door to the care management program, helping identify eligible patients for Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other virtual care services.


The Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist verifies insurance coverage, confirms patient eligibility, answers incoming patient calls, manages voicemail communications, and ensures accurate documentation within electronic medical record (EMR) systems and care management platforms.


The ideal candidate has strong technical proficiency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to navigate multiple healthcare systems efficiently while delivering a professional and compassionate patient experience.


Reports To: Nursing Manager


Department: Clinical Operations

**Job Description**:

**Patient Call Management \& Communication**

* Answer incoming patient calls and provide professional, courteous assistance.
* Respond to patient inquiries related to care management programs and services.
* Manage voicemail systems by reviewing incoming messages and ensuring calls are routed to the appropriate team member or department.
* Coordinate call routing to Care Coordinators, Enrollment Specialists, or other staff based on patient needs.
* Ensure patient messages are handled promptly and accurately to support timely follow\-up.
* Document all patient communications within the care management platform.
* Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA and patient privacy standards during all interactions.

**Insurance Verification \& Eligibility Determination**

* Verify patient insurance coverage and eligibility for care management programs.
* Confirm payer requirements for Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and other services.
* Review patient benefits, coverage status, and eligibility criteria.
* Identify patients who qualify for enrollment in care management programs.
* Document eligibility verification results in the appropriate systems.

**Enrollment Pipeline Support**

* Prepare eligible patient lists for the Enrollment team by verifying eligibility and insurance coverage.
* Flag patients who meet program criteria for outreach and enrollment.
* Support enrollment readiness by ensuring patient demographic and insurance data is accurate.
* Communicate eligibility findings with Enrollment Specialists to support effective patient outreach.
* Assist with administrative preparation for patient enrollment processes.

**Administrative \& Platform Support**

* Maintain accurate patient demographic and insurance information within care management platform.
* Assist with patient record updates and administrative workflows related to care management services.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, complete and compliant with program requirements.
* Support internal teams with patient information verification and administrative tasks.

**Technology \& Data Accuracy**

* Utilize electronic medical records (EMR), care management platforms, and telephony systems to support patient access workflows.
* Demonstrate strong technical proficiency when navigating multiple healthcare platforms simultaneously.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy when entering patient information into healthcare systems.
* Assist with resolving minor data discrepancies and escalate system issues when necessary.

**Qualifications and Skills Required:**

* 1–3 years of experience in healthcare administration, patient access, insurance verification, or care coordination support
* Experience verifying health insurance eligibility and benefits
* Familiarity with Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), or population health programs preferred
* Experience working with electronic medical record (EMR) systems
* Strong technical proficiency and ability to learn new healthcare platforms quickly
* Experience handling patient phone calls in a professional healthcare environment
* Excellent verbal communication and patient engagement skills
* Strong organizational and time management abilities
* High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

**Competencies:**


Competency

  

Definition

  

Patient Communication

  

Provides clear, compassionate communication when assisting patients.

  

Insurance Verification

  

Demonstrates strong understanding of insurance coverage and eligibility processes.

  

Technical Acumen

  

Navigates EMR systems and healthcare technology platforms efficiently.

  

Attention to Detail.

  

Ensures accuracy in documentation and patient data entry.

  

Compliance Awareness

  

Maintains HIPAA compliance and proper handling of protected health information.

  

Organization

  

Manages multiple tasks and systems effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

  

Collaboration

  

Works closely with Enrollment Specialists, Care Coordinators, and operations staff.

  


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Insurance verification accuracy rate
* Eligibility verification turnaround time
* Patient call response quality and timeliness
* Voicemail response and routing accuracy.

**Work Location, Shift \& Schedule**  

  

This position is remote (please see remote requirements below). Shifox/Alopex employees work Monday\-Friday r according to the business hours of client practices.  

  

**Remote Position Requirements:**  

Reliable and stable Internet – all programs used by **Patient Access \& Eligibility Specialist** are internet based. A quiet and professional work environment suitable for speaking with patients about sensitive information and Protected Health Information (PHI), free of distractions.  

  

**Compensation**:

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!


Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best\-in\-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium\-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward\-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.


PEAK 15 part of the Fullsteam organization is a growing software company that provides a cloud\-based management system for the travel industry. Customers include Travel \+ Leisure World’s Best Award winners, National Geographic Expeditions, Micato Safaris, and Butterfield \& Robinson, who use the platform to craft unique itineraries, process bookings, streamline operations, and manage customer and vendor relationships.  



  

PEAK 15 is a collaborative and fast\-paced work environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and development. We are a passionate team committed to customer success and growth, while promoting a positive work culture that values teamwork, transparency, and continuous improvement. PEAK 15 is a 100% remote workforce.  



  

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our team and help ensure our customers derive maximum value from our products and services. As a Customer Success Manager, you will serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of clients and play a key role in guiding customers from post\-sale onboarding through go\-live, product adoption, and long\-term success. This role is responsible for helping customers achieve their business goals, driving effective onboarding and implementation milestones, and ultimately ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.  



  

The ideal candidate will possess a combination of excellent interpersonal skills, a strong customer\-focused mindset, and the ability to proactively address challenges. This role is essential in fostering long\-term relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and acting as the customer’s advocate within the organization.


This role also carries direct responsibility for managing newly onboarding customers through a structured onboarding process, including GUIDEcx project coordination, milestone tracking, weekly customer check\-ins, go\-live readiness, and follow\-up on open action items to ensure a smooth transition into long\-term customer success.  



  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customers, building strong relationships and delivering a consistent, responsive customer experience from onboarding through ongoing account management.
* Guide newly onboarding customers through structured onboarding and implementation workflows, including GUIDEcx project coordination, milestone tracking, weekly customer check\-ins, go\-live readiness, documentation of next steps, and timely follow\-up on open action items.
* Partner with Sales, Learning, Operations, Support, Product, Accounting, and business leadership to coordinate customer handoffs, resolve customer needs, and support timely follow\-through on actions that contribute to customer satisfaction and retention.
* Monitor customer health, product adoption, account activity, and customer requests to identify potential retention risks, adoption barriers, or opportunities to improve the customer experience.
* Participate in periodic account health reviews with customers and internal stakeholders by helping document risks, opportunities, and follow\-up actions.
* Support renewal and contract calendar management by tracking key dates, identifying upcoming customer or internal actions, and coordinating with responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate customer issues that require support beyond standard troubleshooting by gathering relevant information, clarifying urgency and impact, and engaging the appropriate internal resources.
* Track customer issues through resolution, provide timely status updates, document outcomes, and ensure agreed\-upon follow\-up actions are completed.
* Support customer cancellation, transfer\-of\-ownership, and administrative account\-change requests by collecting required information, coordinating with internal stakeholders, and following established documentation, approval, and handoff processes.
* Maintain accurate records of customer communications, onboarding progress, account changes, approvals, effective dates, issue outcomes, and final resolutions in applicable systems.
* Identify recurring customer issues, handoff challenges, or documentation needs and share observations with internal stakeholders to support process improvement.
Provide guidance and recommendations to customers on product features, best practices, and adoption strategies to maximize product usage and value.  
* 

  

**Skills \& Competencies:**

* Proven experience in a customer\-facing role, preferably as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar (2\+ years preferred).
* Strong understanding of customer success principles, customer retention, and product adoption strategies.
* Ability to manage structured customer onboarding projects, track milestones, document next steps, and drive customers through implementation and go\-live timelines.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer accounts and priorities simultaneously. Self\-motivation and organization are highly important.
* Solid problem\-solving skills and the ability to address customer concerns with empathy and professionalism.
*

Regional Key Account Manager responsible for strategic Coatings accounts in North America, driving growth, customer relationships, and key projects while collaborating with Sales, Marketing, Technical, and Global Account teams.

The Regional Key account ( RKA) manager will work closely with the Regional Business Manager, Americas, Global Key Accounts (GKA) managers, Sales managers and the Marketing and Technical Service group/R\&D teams to ensure proper support and alignment. The Key Account Manager will develop a regional plan for their customers and be responsible for ensuring that critical projects are successfully completed. This position will work closely with the regional sales team to achieve revenue and margin targets. Additionally, will be responsible for creating and developing ongoing business relationships in the territory with our customers’ senior managers, technical supervisors, purchasing managers, and chemists to help solve their technical problems.

Keeper is hiring an analytical Senior Implementation Operations Specialist to join our B2B Support team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.



Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and help improve the systems, processes, and resources that support successful customer implementations.


**About Keeper**



Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.


**About the Role**



As a Senior Implementation Operations Specialist, you will independently identify operational challenges, analyze data, manage improvement projects, and develop scalable solutions for the Implementation organization. You will work closely with Implementation leadership and cross\-functional partners to translate complex business needs into clear processes, documentation, training, and measurable improvements. Additionally, the Senior Implementation Operations Specialist will drive initiatives that improve the efficiency, scalability, and maturity of our Implementation organization. This role combines business analysis, project management, process improvement, data validation, stakeholder communication, and training.


**Responsibilities**


* Analyze and validate data from Salesforce, Tableau, and other sources to identify trends, anomalies, root causes, and operational insights
* Build reports and analyses that support Implementation leadership’s decision\-making and provide clear, actionable recommendations
* Identify and manage operational improvement opportunities and strategic initiatives from initial problem identification through delivery
* Gather requirements, develop solutions, manage risks and dependencies, resolve blockers, and measure project outcomes
* Maintain project documentation, status updates, and visibility through Jira and other project management tools
* Develop a strong understanding of Keeper’s product suite and Implementation processes to identify meaningful opportunities for improvement
* Evaluate and improve existing processes while developing scalable solutions involving tools, automation, reporting, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Partner with internal stakeholders to define requirements, coordinate solutions, and validate that delivered solutions meet operational needs
* Create clear documentation, process guidance, and supporting resources that promote consistent execution
* Design and deliver training for new processes, tools, and operational changes, including follow\-up to support adoption
* Communicate clearly and professionally with team members, cross\-functional partners, and leadership
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, and opportunities, using sound judgment to determine when escalation is appropriate
* Participate in special projects and continuously evaluate opportunities to improve operational efficiency and results


**Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in a business\-related field or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of progressive experience in operations, implementation, project management, business analysis, or a related role
* Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to build, analyze, and validate reports
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements and actionable solutions
* Experience managing projects from problem identification through delivery
* Strong organizational skills, execution, and follow\-through across multiple concurrent initiatives
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience facilitating cross\-functional discussions, driving alignment, and managing risks or escalations
* Experience creating process documentation, training materials, and operational resources
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Tableau or similar business intelligence tools
* Strong computer skills; Google Workspace or Microsoft Office experience strongly preferred
* Strong proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Ability to work effectively autonomously and as part of a team


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience supporting SaaS implementations, customer onboarding, or professional services
* Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, technology, or enterprise software
* Experience with process improvement, automation, or operational efficiency initiatives
* Experience working with Jira or other project management tools
* Familiarity with change management and process adoption


**Benefits**


* Medical, Dental \& Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)
* Employer Paid Life Insurance \& Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
* Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
* 401k (Roth/Traditional)
* A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

jobs.description:
Description:

Quantum Sky is searching for an **Instructional Designer** supporting the Marine Corps Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) Operations and Sustainment (O\&S) program. In this role, you will design, develop, maintain, and update training solutions supporting Marine Corps ITSM processes and BMC Remedy/Helix functionality.


You will work closely with the training team, customer stakeholders, and technical subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure training materials remain current as ITSM processes, workflows, and system capabilities evolve.

 **Responsibilities:****Training Development**
------------------------

* Design and develop interactive computer\-based courseware for technical and end\-user training.
* Convert complex technical information, workflows, and requirements into clear instructional content.
* Develop storyboards, flow diagrams, scenarios, simulations, and supporting training materials.
* Create and update CBTs, JIT videos, QRGs, and Job Aids.
* Ensure training products remain aligned with current BMC Remedy/Helix functionality and USMC ITSM processes.

**Stakeholder and SME Collaboration**
-------------------------------------

* Work directly with technical SMEs and customer stakeholders to understand system changes, process updates, and new training requirements.
* Validate the technical accuracy and usability of instructional content.
* Participate in reviews, demonstrations, and working sessions with program and customer teams.

**Training Environment Support**
--------------------------------

* Support validation of training environments against production configurations.
* Coordinate with technical teams to test training procedures and system workflows.
* Help ensure courseware remains synchronized with system releases and configuration changes.

**Project and Quality Support**
-------------------------------

* Develop work plans, schedules, estimates, and status updates for assigned training activities.
* Track assigned deliverables through completion and provide input to weekly and monthly program reporting.
* Participate in peer reviews and quality checks of training products.
* Maintain consistency with established style, quality, and instructional\-design standards.
* Maintain training records and documentation supporting CMMI and internal quality processes.

**Training products include:*** SCORM 2004\-compliant Computer\-Based Training (CBT) modules developed using the Marine Corps Systems Approach to Training (SAT) methodology and ADDIE model.
* Just\-in\-Time (JIT) training videos covering core CBT and system functionality.
* Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), Job Aids, and other end\-user support materials.


Qualifications:
**Required:*** 5\+ years of applicable instructional\-design, training\-development, or technical\-training experience.
* A. or B.S. degree in Instructional Design, Business, Organizational Development, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing technical training for government, DoD, or large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience using Adobe Captivate and Adobe editing tools, including Audition, and the Microsoft Office suite.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification and strong operational knowledge of the ITIL framework.
* Experience developing SCORM\-compliant eLearning materials.
* Ability to quickly learn technical software platforms and translate system functionality into effective user training.
* Strong written communication, editing, facilitation, and organizational skills.
* Experience developing branched learning scenarios, simulations, and interactive training.
* Experience working with SMEs to validate technical content.
* Familiarity with training environments, software releases, testing, and configuration changes.
* Adobe Captivate and/or Articulate 360 experience.

**Desired:*** Experience with BMC Remedy, BMC Helix, ServiceNow, or another enterprise ITSM platform.
* Experience supporting USMC or DoD ITSM environments.
* Familiarity with Marine Corps SAT / ADDIE methodology.
* Experience developing training for software migrations or major system modernization efforts.
* Experience with AI\-enabled content development, knowledge management, or training automation.
* Master's degree in Instructional Design, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Certified Technical Trainer (CTT\+) or another relevant industry training certification.

**Clearance:*** Active Secret clearance required.

**Location:*** The work location will be remote with some potential limited travel to Quantico, Virginia, as required.
