jobs.title: Learning and Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


As Net at Work continues to evolve its internal systems, processes, and technology platforms, we are seeking a Systems Learning Specialist to support employee readiness, technology adoption, and learning enablement across the organization.

  

The Systems Learning Specialist plays a key role in helping employees successfully adopt and utilize business systems, tools, and processes. This role partners closely with Learning \& Development, Systems Operations, and business stakeholders to transform system requirements, workflows, and process updates into engaging and effective learning experiences.

  

This position is focused on the execution of training initiatives, including content development, facilitation, documentation, and user adoption support across multiple technology platforms.

 **Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced training programs for employees.
* Create engaging learning materials including presentations, job aids, quick reference guides, videos, process documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Support employee adoption of business systems including ticketing platforms, HR systems, collaboration tools, and operational applications.
* Translate system updates, process changes, and business requirements into clear learning content.
* Conduct platform walkthroughs, testing, and hands\-on exploration to understand workflows and user experiences before developing training materials.
* Facilitate new system launches, enhancements, and adoption initiatives.
* Assist with AI enablement efforts by developing and delivering foundational AI learning content and best practices.
* Maintain and update training materials to ensure content remains accurate and current.
* Partner with subject matter experts to gather information and validate training effectiveness.
* Support employee onboarding and ongoing learning initiatives related to business systems and technology tools.
* Track participation, feedback, and adoption metrics to continuously improve learning programs.

 **Job Requirements**

* 2\-5 years of experience in corporate training, learning and development, employee enablement, instructional design, or systems training.
* Experience creating training content and learning materials.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new software platforms and business processes.
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including PowerPoint, Teams, Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting software implementations or system rollouts.
* Experience with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, HRIS platforms, or workflow applications.
* Familiarity with learning management systems and digital learning tools.
* Experience creating video\-based learning content or microlearning assets.
* Exposure to AI tools and AI\-assisted content development.

 **Customer Requirements**


This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

 **Core Competencies**

* **Client Champion** – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
* **Problem Solver** – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge\-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
* **Promise Keeper** – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
* **Collaborative Integrator** –Team player, unifier, relationship\-oriented, win\-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
* **Driven Intrapreneur** – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self\-confidence, and a can\-do attitude.
* **Inspiring Coach** – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


Base salary range: $85,000 to $95,000\.


This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

  

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product\-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.

* Health and Welfare (Medical, Dental, Vision)

jobs.title: Claims Support Supervisor - Auto Insurance
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**  

  

Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for a Claims Support Supervisor to join our team. Family\-owned, UAIC, is one of the largest privately held property and casualty insurance companies in the United States. The key to our growth and success is a commitment to providing quality service to our agents and customers, by providing disciplined underwriting, and strategic claims handling. Our ongoing efforts to invest substantial resources in personnel and technology are the foundation of our promise of assuring maximum efficiency and specialized operations in the industry. We are proud that our independent agents and customers have recognized our dedication by making UAIC the market leader in every state where we conduct business.  

  

***This postion offers remote work in the South East Region***  

  

**SCOPE**  

  

The Claims Support Supervisor leads licensed adjusters who provide elevated claim service, explain coverage and liability information, process first\-party claim payments, and make decisions that move insured losses toward closure. The supervisor provides operational direction, quality oversight, coaching, and escalation support while ensuring work remains within team authority. Matters requiring upper\-level investigation, complex coverage determinations, negotiation, or settlement with claimants are referred to the appropriate adjusting staff.  

  

**KEY DUTIES*** Lead, coach, and support a team of licensed fast track adjusters serving as elevated points of contact for policyholders and claimants.
* Oversee accurate processing of first payments to insureds, shops, and related parties, as well as reissuance of payments previously issued on a claim.

Manages, plans, administers, and coordinates the administrative operations in the Department of Otolaryngology \-Head \& Neck Surgery. The department is within the School of Medicine. The position reports to the Chief Administrative Officer.


The department has a continuous stream of staffing and academic activity that requires the ability to work in partnership with Human Resources Shared Services and the Office of Faculty and Academic Affairs, with expertise in recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, leaves of absence, recognition, HR Oracle transaction processing, and other related areas.


Additional responsibilities include providing executive and senior leadership with HR/Academic Affairs strategic consultation, assigning HR\-related project management goals, providing high\-level data reporting, and independently executing all newly assigned duties as directed by the Chief Administrative Officer and department Chair. Also, provides ongoing strategic policy and operational process consultation. Provides triage consultation to executive leadership and advises management on complex performance management, disciplinary actions, union grievances, and internal investigations. The predominant focus of this position is the performance of administrative operations activities; performs short\- and long\-term planning for the department. Exercises sound judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve goals may result in additional costs and negatively impact departmental operations and employee morale.


**Department Overview**


The Department of Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery is a clinical department at UCSF that combines superior resident and medical student training with the highest\-quality patient care. Beyond our offices, clinics, and laboratories within the 107\-acre UCSF Parnassus campus above Golden Gate Park, our department reaches into the Moffitt Long Hospital, the Ambulatory Care Center, the Medical Center at Mount Zion, and shares UCSF’s partnerships with Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (SFVAMC).


Divisions within OHNS include Pediatric Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, Laryngology, Otology/Neurotology, Rhinology, Minimally Invasive Skull\-Based Surgery, Facial Plastic Surgery, and Sleep Disorders. The department ranked \#1 in Northern California by U.S. News \& World Report in 2021 and \#5 in the nation. We also have a robust research enterprise with 10 PhD faculty and a $10M sponsored research budget for FY26\. OHNS has consistently been ranked in the top 10 institutions for NIH funding. The department has an ACGME\-accredited residency program with 25 residents. Additionally, four fellows receive subspecialty training annually.

* Minimum of five years of related work experience

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **Position: Program Manager**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA**


Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEM’s globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales and manufacturing locations globally.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position will be responsible for customer communication, program planning, program budget, and program execution. Manage and provide Technical Leadership for new product development programs with high complexity. Manage these programs to ensure that products/technologies are delivered according to market/customer expectations in respect of specifications, timing and budget.

* Manage the program, the program team, contribute to the program scope and program objectives as well as assure that all steps are completed.
* Provide communication interface to customer for communication of program status, schedule, requirements, etc.
* Manage and provide Technical Leadership to program teams across multiple sites throughout the execution of product development programs.
* Schedule and manage internal team meetings to address necessary action items and keep programs on schedule.
* Manage internal and external suppliers for on time completion of actions.
* Timely communication to management for resource requirements to keep programs on schedule.
* Define product specifications and program scope to ensure it is in line with market / customer needs and ensure development of the product / process accordingly.
* Make sure that programs are in accordance with the financial objectives including creation, review, submission of capital requests, review and submittal of product costing information and managing program scope creep.
* Make decisions in order to speed up the process and ensure the best time to market, time to volume and time to profitability.
* Ensure application of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles during the product development.
* Ensure that capacity planning is performed through the program phases so that supply meets expected demand.
* Provide program updates to functional management on a regular basis.
* Ensure systems are set up for ordering / manufacturing of products.
* Manage \& reduce risks including the development of alternatives using risk reduction tools in order to maintain program objectives and schedules.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from a four\-year university with 4\+ years related experience and/or training within the connector industry, preferred.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret technical product drawings.
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret technical procedures, write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from various levels of management.
* Ability to effectively manage customer communication and expectations.
* Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

	+ Project Management software
	+ Spreadsheet software (Excel)
	+ Word Processing software (Word)
	+ Presentation software (PowerPoint)

* Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal supervision and provide updates on project status where issues or problems can be reviewed, discussed and resolved.
* Root cause analysis.

new_jobs.description:
***Senior Project Manager*** Commercial Solar, Battery Storage \& Microgrids \| Sausalito, CA (Hybrid)

ABOUT THE COMPANY Our client is a well\-established independent energy consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience serving public agencies across California. Acting as a trusted owner's representative, the firm provides objective technical and project management expertise to help public\-sector clients plan, design, and deploy on\-site energy projects. These include solar, battery storage, EV charging, biogas generation, and in\-line hydro, and they reduce grid energy use and operating expenses.

The result for clients is energy infrastructure that lowers costs, strengthens resiliency through backup power, and advances sustainability goals. The firm is now rebuilding its internal systems to power its next chapter of growth. Its five\-year vision is to become a leaner, more tech\-forward, data\-driven organization and the go\-to energy consultant for public agencies in California.

LOCATION \& TRAVEL **Sausalito, CA. Hybrid schedule: in office Tuesday through Thursday, remote Monday and Friday.**  Travel for site walks and on\-site client meetings, typically one to two visits per month.

POSITION SUMMARY The Senior Project Manager will lead the deployment of commercial\-scale solar, battery storage, and microgrid projects for public\-sector clients throughout California. Serving as the owner's representative, you will guide projects from contract execution through commissioning and keep schedules, budgets, and technical requirements on track.

This role is built for a seasoned project leader who operates independently, thrives in complexity, solves problems proactively, and provides steady leadership to contractors, consultants, and public\-agency stakeholders. Hands\-on experience with the permitting processes and requirements of California electric utilities (PG\&E, SCE, SDG\&E, etc.), the State of California, counties, fire departments, and other AHJs is a must.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES **Lead microgrid projects: Manage advanced microgrid projects in California from contract signing through commissioning.**  Strengthen critical infrastructure: Support water and wastewater utilities in deploying resilient energy solutions that provide backup power and reduce electricity costs. **Work with experienced professionals: Collaborate with a small, highly experienced team with deep expertise in California's energy landscape.**  Make a meaningful impact: Deliver projects that directly support community resilience and long\-term sustainability.

QUALIFICATIONS **Demonstrated project management experience delivering commercial solar and battery storage projects in California.**  Engineering degree or equivalent technical experience. **Strong understanding of California utility rates, tariffs, permitting, and interconnection processes.**  Proven ability to lead contractors and guide public\-agency or institutional clients through complex projects. **Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.**  Self\-motivated, resourceful problem solver focused on communication and results.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE **Engineer holding a professional credential such as PMP, PE, or an equivalent project management or engineering certification.**  Background in project development, project management, or project engineering. **Track record managing commercial\-scale, behind\-the\-meter solar, battery storage, and/or microgrid projects (infrastructure and facilities) for California public agencies, utilities, municipalities, and special districts.**  Strong, clear communicator. **Customer\-centric with a genuine service mentality. Early in each engagement, the role focuses on advising and educating clients so they have the information to make the right decision for their needs. It then shifts to helping them build their projects.**

Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sausalito, CA 94965

* Experience in Circular Economy work streams, such as Trade\-in operations, Certified Pre\-Owned, or Refurbished sales businesses.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing complex, cross\-functional, or cross\-team projects with significant technical expertise.
* Experience in the consumer electronics hardware industry, particularly with product lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of the post\-sales value chain and experience designing new programs to drive growth in global markets (US, Japan, Europe).

-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. You will bridge the gap between engineering, product management, and business units to ensure our post\-sales value chain is sustainable, profitable, and globally scalable. You will not only manage timelines and risks but also drive the strategic direction for circular economy initiatives, influencing how our hardware lives on through second and third life cycles.

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

--------------------

* Be part of strategic planning and execution of Residual Value (RV) and Certified Pre\-Owned (CPO) work streams, ensuring alignment with broader company objectives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional partners across product, supply chain, and engineering to solve complex operational bottlenecks and drive technical implementations.
* Own large\-scale project schedules from start to finish, identifying risks and communicating progress clearly to executive stakeholders across different time zones.
* Develop and standardize operational workflows for global CPO programs, focusing on key markets including the US, Japan, and Europe.
* Drive continuous process improvements in the post\-sales value chain, utilizing data analytics to uphold data integrity and uncover strategic insights.

-----------------


As a Program Manager for the AI \& Gemini App Marketing team, you will serve as a key operational engine connecting product and marketing strategy to seamless execution. SFEI’s Environmental Informatics \& Clean Water Programs are looking to add 1\-2 motivated Project Managers to help focus and facilitate the success of our technical teams as we tackle multi\-million dollar science and technology projects with regional and national impacts.

**POSITION: Program Manager I, Prevention \& Youth**  

**DEPARTMENT: Community Wellness Department (CWD)**  

**REPORTS TO: Senior Program Manager**  

**LOCATION: Native American Health Center, Inc. (NAHC)**  

**WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE**  

**STATUS: Non\-Union, Exempt**

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Community Wellness Department’s program goals include maximizing the quality of the member experience and clinical outcomes. This is achieved through an integrated, team\-oriented, strengths\-based holistic healthcare approach. CWD incorporates prevention, community\-engagement and cultural\-competence, and integration of behavioral health treatment with a particular focus on the local urban Native American community. This approach allows staff and trainees to develop their skills and creates an environment conducive to professional growth and intercultural proficiency.


The Program Manager I (PM I) provides management, support, and implementation of grants within the Community Wellness Department, across multiple sites, and may include supervision of staff members to execute a scope of work. The incumbent plays the primary role in the development and implementation of site programming to ensure attainment of successful internal and grant outcomes including improved community access, system navigation, program sustainability and integration of services. The PM I is responsible for facilitating implementation and delivery of culturally\-based prevention activities and afterschool learning curriculum, including groups, cultural activities, and linkages to traditional knowledge and resources across both NAHC sites and with  

collaborating partners. Additionally, the PM I will be responsible for supervision, leadership, and guidance to the CWD team and oversight of youth engagement and program development. This might also include supervision of volunteers and interns, financial management, event planning, and strategy development.


The Native American Health Center is an accredited institution and adheres to the standards of excellence set forth by the Accreditation Association of Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC) and the Commission of Dental Accreditation (CODA).

11\. Address performance issues with staff in a proactive manner consistent with NAHC policy and procedures. Provide training opportunities and corrective  

actions to improve performance and build staff capacity.  

12\. Ensure meaningful participation by family, youth, and community members in prevention and evaluation processes via design, interpretation, and  

dissemination of findings.  

13\. Represent the program in meetings, task forces, and partner collaborations.

outcomes occur.

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world\-renowned care begins with world\-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family\-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state\-of\-the\-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team \- like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  

  

**Job ID:** P146452\-3300

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.


The Assistant Patient Care Manager is responsible for assisting the Patient Care Manager with clinical management and administrative coordination of a designated patient care unit(s) or service(s). The position supports the Patient Care Manager in promoting the achievement of the unit(s)' goals and objectives. This position works in a supportive manner as a resource for the patient care unit(s) and as a representative for the Patient Care Manager. Typically assigned responsibility for supervising patient care staff and operations for an assigned shift for a patient care unit(s) and/or for coordinating one or more administrative functions as assigned by the Patient Care Manager, ensuring consistent implementation and monitoring of organizational policies and standards of care, their work involves a combination of clinical (patient care) and administrative responsibilities. The Assistant Patient Care Manager provides consistent and timely information and feedback to the Patient Care Manager and is responsible for knowledge and application of all personnel policies and requirements of the collective bargaining agreements. Assistant Patient Care Managers differ from Patient Care Managers in that the latter are unit managers with total responsibility and accountability for one or more patient care units or services.

new_jobs.title: Curriculum & Fellowship Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Involves designing, conducting, promoting, evaluating and supporting health professions education programs in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements. Supports learners (including but not limited to faculty, residents, clinical fellows, graduate or undergraduate learners, practicing or licensed professionals) in areas such as curriculum, teaching and learning activities, scheduling, core competencies, assessment and evaluations. Coordinates all activities associated with ongoing administration of health professions education programs.


Applies acquired skills, process, and policy knowledge to support professional health education program learners. Coordinates program operations, which include teaching and learning activities, program curriculum, learner scheduling, maintaining databases, tracking learner compliance, and program accreditation.


The Program Analyst for the Resident and Medical Student Education Office works under supervision of the Administrative Director and is responsible for the management and preparation new hire paperwork, appointment, and separation processes for all departmental residents, ACGME fellows and non\-ACGME fellows (appointed through the GME Office) at all sites (Parnassus/Mt. Zion, SFGH, SFVAMC, Kaiser and CPMC); maintenance of the MedHub and ACGME WebADS systems, ACGME Faculty and Resident surveys, and National GME Census; management of complex HR functions (FMLA/leave of absences and visa applications and renewals); support of payroll processing for all residents and fellows; support of event planning/coordination; other duties as assigned.


**Department Overview**

The Department of Surgery is a large clinical department comprised of eight divisions and over 500 employees (Campus and Medical Center staff, faculty, academic research staff, residents, clinical and post doctoral fellows). The Department, through its faculty and staff, conducts teaching, performs research, provides patient care services and performs service to the community. At the center of the educational mission are the trainee residency and fellowship programs. The Department of Surgery has 2 residency and 10 fellowship programs. Many of our trainees go on to become national leaders in research, clinical care or education.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Minimum 3 years related experience.
* Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. Solid knowledge of medical education program requirements. Thorough knowledge of medical education industry.
* Thorough knowledge of administrative analysis and operations research. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement processes and systems. Thorough knowledge of the administrative and operational implications in a program.
* Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; includes active listening and critical thinking.
* Strong interpersonal skills. Actively cooperates and supports the work of others. Ability to work productively with anyone regardless of background. Empathetic and aware of impact on others. Strong problem solving skills to resolve issues.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical, and demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to complete work and meet established deadlines in an accurate and timely manner, and to manage short and competing deadlines.
* Thorough knowledge of data management, documentation methods used in investigating and presenting findings about the program. Skills include statistical analysis of data across databases and systems.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Operations Liaison (Temporary, Remote)
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------


At Sprinter Health, our mission is to dramatically expand access to healthcare by reimagining the patient experience—delivered at home and powered by technology for scale.


We’re building the technology and clinical services platform to make preventive, connected healthcare accessible for everyone in the US. We deliver hybrid care (in\-home \+ virtual) backed by data products across 15\+ states, serving 60%\+ of the US population through major health plans and systems. With 1M\+ patients and 92\+ NPS, we’re rapidly scaling our impact. Our team of technologists, clinicians, and operators is backed by investors including a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel.


We have a rapidly growing team of visionary leaders who are passionate about increasing access to care, lowering healthcare costs, and improving outcomes for patients.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------


We are growing rapidly and are looking for a Clinical Operations Liaison to support our clinical leaders as we scale our field operations and clinical teams. You’ll be the connective thread between our NPs and Sprinters (our clinician field staff) and the operational systems that keep them paid, trained, and compliant — handling workforce tracking, payroll compliance follow\-up, documentation review, and reporting so clinical leadership can stay focused on patient care, clinical support, and clinical oversight.


We’re not just looking for someone to execute a checklist. As we scale, we want someone who notices where a workflow is clunky, a tracker is out of date, or a process could run smoother — and speaks up about it. You’ll have real opportunities to help shape how these processes evolve.


This is a **remote full\-time temporary position**. This role reports to the Director of Quality \& Training.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

### **Workforce \& Payroll Compliance**

* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for NPs and Sprinters on timesheet, mileage, and documentation questions
* Follow up with field employees on timesheet submissions, PTO entries and approval, and sick time to ensure accuracy before each payroll close
* Validate weekly mileage and hours are submitted in accordance with policy and protocols
* Review and abstract supporting documentation for mileage and time submissions
* Approve expenses within set parameters
* Data pulls and tracking for peer audits, bonus incentives
* Deliver a weekly exception report to each manager — escalations only, with full documentation
* Other duties as assigned

### **Workforce Operations \& Reporting**

* Maintain clinical employee attendance, call\-off, and workforce planning trackers
* Track training completion in Sprinter University and annual compliance for clinical teams
* Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports for your assigned clinical area
* Support logistical planning for workforce
* Maintain dashboards, trackers, and workforce metrics
* Other duties as assigned

### **Escalation \& Program Support**

* Manage administrative escalation trackers and ensure timely follow\-up on open items
* Route non\-clinical operational issues to appropriate teams
* Maintain SOPs, workflows, and operational documentation
* Track project milestones and action items; support new workflow launches as directed by the In\-Home Director

### **Compliance \& Quality**

* Participate in internal audits; identify documentation gaps and recommend process improvements
* Flag recurring issues or inefficiencies in existing workflows and propose fixes to your manager
* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and compliance standards

**YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF**
---------------------------

* You take pride in accuracy and integrity, finding satisfaction in getting every detail right
* You’re motivated by mission as much as metrics — knowing your work directly supports better access to preventive and chronic care for patients nationwide
* You thrive in a tech\-forward, fast\-growing environment where innovation and continuous improvement are part of the daily rhythm
* You enjoy working independently in a remote setting while staying connected to a collaborative, purpose\-driven team
* You’re naturally curious, proactive, and eager to contribute feedback and shape evolving processes
* Most of all, you value flexibility, accountability, and being part of a company that’s reimagining how healthcare reaches people where they are

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------


You will thrive at Sprinter Health if you have:

* A desire to work collaboratively with a tight\-knit but quickly growing team across many different areas of the business
* Flexibility, humility, and a sense of humor
* Excitement for working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment

**Experience and Skills:**

* 2\+ years in an operations, coordination, or administrative support role
* Experience managing multiple workflows, trackers, or reports simultaneously
* 2\+ years of demonstrated success identifying and implementing AI\-driven solutions to optimized workflows and improve operational success
* Comfortable working independently and remotely with minimal day\-to\-day direction
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Proficient in EHR systems and Google tools
* Reliable internet connection and dedicated, secure workspace
* Available to work CST or PST hours

**Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare operations, medical group administration, or home health/home care
* Familiarity with multi\-state payroll or leave compliance
* Experience supporting a distributed or regional field team
* Prior use of Rippling or a similar HRIS platform

**THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE**
------------------------------

* Disciplinary action or performance management
* Clinical, patient\-facing, or care coordination responsibilities

**TECHNOLOGIES WE USE**
-----------------------

* Slack
* Google Suite (Docs, Slides, Sheets)
* Rippling or similar HRIS platform

Stanford Health Care

Serves as the subject\-matter expert for an assigned strategic initiative or transformation program, owning the analytical framework, program design, and stakeholder coordination that drive successful strategy development and organizational change. Advises senior leaders on strategic direction and transformation program design.  

  

The Strategy and Transformation Lead operates with minimal supervision and is the primary point of accountability for assigned strategic initiatives. Decisions impact function\-wide strategic outcomes, and the role synthesizes input across clinical, operational, financial, and leadership stakeholders.
‎

**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**


‎

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Own the analytical framework and program design for an assigned strategic initiative or transformation program, independently determining approach and methodology.
* Lead end\-to\-end strategy development workstreams, including problem framing, data analysis, recommendation development, and executive alignment.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior and executive leaders on strategic direction, organizational transformation, and change management.
* Drive cross\-functional coordination across clinical, operational, finance, and HR stakeholders to execute transformation initiatives.
* Identify organizational risks and systemic barriers to strategy execution, developing well\-supported recommendations for program improvement.
* Coach and provide guidance to Strategy and Transformation Consultant\-level staff.
* Develop strategy program tools, analytical frameworks, and transformation management resources that support enterprise\-wide strategic execution.
 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, finance, economics, organizational development, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 7\+ years of progressively responsible experience in strategy, management consulting, strategic operations, transformation, healthcare operations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience independently leading complex strategic initiatives or transformation programs from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
* Advanced ability to structure ambiguous business problems, develop analytical frameworks, synthesize quantitative and qualitative information, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience advising and influencing senior leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders on strategic priorities, operating models, organizational change, or transformation initiatives.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to assess operational, financial, organizational, and strategic implications of proposed decisions.
* Experience coordinating complex initiatives across multiple functions, such as clinical operations, business operations, finance, HR, technology, and/or other enterprise functions.
* Demonstrated ability to identify systemic barriers, organizational dependencies, and execution risks and develop practical, evidence\-based solutions.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing executive\-level presentations, recommendations, decision materials, and strategic narratives.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal supervision, exercise sound judgment, and independently determine appropriate methods and approaches for complex assignments.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, or providing substantive guidance to less\-experienced strategy, operations, or consulting professionals.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, public health, organizational development, or a related discipline.
* Experience in healthcare strategy, healthcare operations, value\-based care, clinical transformation, or healthcare delivery transformation.

**Overview**
------------

***To qualify for US internships, you must be currently enrolled in a degree\-seeking program with an expected graduation date after the internship/co\-op ends. If you do not meet this requirement, we invite you to explore other opportunities available on our careers website.***  

Intuit internships are 12 weeks throughout the summer. We have fixed start and end dates that are designed to work with various universities’ academic calendars.* ***Cohort 1: Monday, May 17 \- Friday, August 6, 2027 (12 weeks)***
* ***Cohort 2: Monday, June 14 \- Friday September 3, 2027 (12 weeks)***

 **About our Emerging Talent Program:**


Intuit invests in Emerging Talent because fresh perspectives strengthen our products and teams. The program is backed by a culture that values curiosity and collaboration, and you'll be supported by dedicated managers and mentors who are invested in your growth. As an intern or co\-op, you'll work on meaningful projects with business impact, many centered on AI and emerging technologies, and contribute to driving decisions. You'll build skills through function\-specific learning opportunities, connect with a global community of interns and co\-ops through dedicated programming and social events, and get exposure to senior leadership and cross\-functional work across Intuit's product ecosystem. Learn more about our Intern and Co\-op Program here. **About the Team**  

At Intuit, we believe in the power of early talent. Our internship and co\-op program provides hands\-on experience, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to real\-world projects that impact millions. We get up every morning with our hearts beating fast, driven by the knowledge that we're transforming the world of consumer and small business finance. It's why our products continue to resonate with 50 million consumers around the globe. SMB and Business Platform is home to QuickBooks, the core product for tens of millions of small businesses worldwide. Within this organization, the SMB Business Operations (BizOps) team sits embedded with each product VP, from QBO Core to IAS/Accountants, Omni, Customer Growth, and Commercial, turning ambiguous business problems into decisions leadership can act on. Join us as a Product Strategy and Business Operations MBA Intern. You will rotate across BizOps pods to get broad exposure to how a platform business this size actually runs strategy and operations, not a single narrow project, but the full range of problems a BizOps team owns: product and roadmap prioritization, market and competitive assessment, executive communication, KPI definition, and the connective work between product, marketing, and finance. This role is a strong fit for candidates with a management consulting background, or MBAs using the summer to test consulting as a post\-MBA path. The work mirrors a consulting engagement: a defined problem, a data\-backed recommendation, and a stakeholder who acts on it, but built inside an operating business rather than delivered to a client. **Responsibilities**


 Partner with BizOps leads and product VPs across two or more pods (QBO Core, IAS/Accountants, Omni, Customer Growth, Commercial) to get hands\-on exposure to how product strategy and operations differ by business context.* Take on a defined product strategy project with a named business owner and a measurable outcome, for example a market sizing analysis, a

executive\-ready materials (strategy memos, business reviews) that name the problem before the recommendation.* Sit in on pod operating rhythms (staff meetings, business reviews) to see how decisions actually get made and tracked.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Growth)
new_jobs.description:
**About Veritus**
-----------------


Veritus Agent is building the first fully AI\-native voice agent platform for consumer lending and collections. We're a YC\-backed team with leadership from Best Egg, PayPal, Divvy, and Lending Club—on a mission to modernize legacy call centers with real\-time AI agents that drive higher conversions, lower costs, and better borrower outcomes.

**About the role**
------------------


You'll be the main point of contact for a book of our Growth customers — collection agencies, lenders and fintechs — from kickoff through go\-live, renewal and expansion.


Internally, you're the bridge to our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who build and tune each customer's agents. You turn customer asks into clear requests for the team, and turn build updates back into plain language for the customer.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the customer relationship**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a book of Growth accounts, with a prescriptive and consultative approach
* Run regular check\-ins: agent performance, what shipped, what's blocked and what the customer owes us
* Send clear recaps after every call so decisions and next steps are never ambiguous
* Communicate with every level of the customer's team, from collections floor managers and IT leads to owners and C\-level executives

**Get agents live and performing**

* Guide customers through their deployment journey, from kickoff and scoping to go\-live, adoption and measurable results
* Chase the inputs a launch depends on — scripts, compliance sign\-off, data files, phone numbers, integration access — without letting timelines drift
* Monitor account health signals (using customer metrics) and step in early when something slips
* Translate build updates, trade\-offs and timelines back to customers in plain language
* Relay customer insights to our engineering team so what we learn in one account improves every agent

**Grow the book**

* Drive pilot\-to\-annual conversions and renewals across your accounts
* Spot and qualify expansion: new channels, a second agent, a new portfolio or client of the customer
* Help build our scaled Growth motion — onboarding templates, email cadences and self\-serve materials that let one CSM run many accounts well

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role at a tech company (customer success, account management, implementation or support) **or** in lending or collections operations (at a lender, servicer, agency or fintech)
* Hands\-on experience rolling out automation, AI or contact\-center technology to an operations team — and judging whether it's actually working
* Excellent written communication: your recaps, emails and tickets are short, specific and impossible to misread
* Excellent verbal communication: you can run a call with an agency owner, simplify a technical concept for a non\-technical customer, and hold a firm position politely
* Maturity and sound judgment: you own mistakes, deliver bad news early, and flag problems before the customer notices them
* Comfort managing many accounts and moving parts at once, with a structured way to prioritize what matters today
* A data\-driven approach to spotting risk early, and comfort in spreadsheets and a CRM
* Collaborative, empathetic and low\-ego; you like working closely with engineers

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Working knowledge of collections: delinquency stages, settlements and payment plans, first\- vs third\-party collections
* Familiarity with collections compliance (FDCPA, Reg F, TCPA) or regulated consumer\-finance workflows
* Experience with AI agents, conversational AI or contact\-center software
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot, Linear or similar CRM and ticketing tools
* Experience at an early\-stage startup

**Location and compensation**
-----------------------------

* **Location:** San Francisco (hybrid in\-office)
* **Base salary:** $120,000–$180,000 depending on experience
* **Equity:** meaningful early\-stage equity
* **Benefits:** health, dental, vision, 401(k), other perks

new_jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU?**



Box is redefining how enterprises manage and unlock value from their content in an AI\-first world. In this role, you will partner with enterprise customers not only to adopt Box, but to transform how work gets done across their organization using content and AI.



You will serve as a strategic advisor and operator, helping customers understand their current content workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and design future\-state solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.



You will work closely with executive stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to align on priorities, drive change management, and ensure that Box delivers tangible impact. This role represents the evolution of Customer Success at Box—from driving adoption to driving transformation. The ideal candidate combines customer success, consulting, and solution\-oriented thinking—someone who is curious about how businesses operate, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by driving real outcomes.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the post\-sales relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes and long\-term value realization
* Partner with customers to map and redesign critical workflows
* + Identify and activate AI\-powered use cases within these workflows
* Translate customer goals into a clear value hypothesis, success metrics and practical AI solutions
* Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of new workflows and behaviors, including stakeholder alignment, enablement and executive engagement
* Conduct strategic adoption business reviews that focus on outcomes, ROI and future opportunities
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities within accounts, using both qualitative insight and data to guide action
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering and Professional Services to:
* + Expand Box's footprint within the customer
	+ Influence product direction based on real\-world use cases
	+ Deliver cohesive, high\-impact solutions
* Serve as the voice of the customer, bringing structured insights on workflows, pain points and AI opportunities back to internal team

**WHO YOU ARE**



We are an AI\-first company. You approach your work with a growth mindset and actively look for ways to leverage AI to drive smarter decisions, unlock new use cases, and increase your impact


* 4\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer\-facing managing a book of business
* Experience working with enterprise customers and engaging with senior stakeholders and executives
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into practical solutions and business outcomes
* Strong ability to navigate technical and business conversations, including discussing integrations, systems, and data flows at a high level
* Solid hands\-on experience with modern AI platforms and tools, with enough technical depth to understand, evaluate, and challenge solutions without needing to write production code
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate value clearly and persuasively
* Highly proactive, self\-directed and team player who brings fresh ideas for user adoption, churn mitigation and expansion
* Demonstrated ability to share expertise, develop best practices and contribute to the broader success of the team

Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

This role represents the evolution of Customer Success at Box—from driving adoption to driving transformation. The ideal candidate combines customer success, consulting, and solution\-oriented thinking—someone who is curious about how businesses operate, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by driving real outcomes.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the post\-sales relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes and long\-term value realization
* Partner with customers to map and redesign critical workflows
* + Identify and activate AI\-powered use cases within these workflows
* Translate customer goals into a clear value hypothesis, success metrics and practical AI solutions
* Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of new workflows and behaviors, including stakeholder alignment, enablement and executive engagement
* Conduct strategic adoption business reviews that focus on outcomes, ROI and future opportunities
* Proactively identify risks and opportunities within accounts, using both qualitative insight and data to guide action
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering and Professional Services to:
* + Expand Box's footprint within the customer
	+ Influence product direction based on real\-world use cases
	+ Deliver cohesive, high\-impact solutions
* Serve as the voice of the customer, bringing structured insights on workflows, pain points and AI opportunities back to internal team

**WHO YOU ARE**



We are an AI\-first company. You approach your work with a growth mindset and actively look for ways to leverage AI to drive smarter decisions, unlock new use cases, and increase your impact


* 4\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer\-facing managing a book of business
* Experience working with enterprise customers and engaging with senior stakeholders and executives
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into practical solutions and business outcomes
* Strong ability to navigate technical and business conversations, including discussing integrations, systems, and data flows at a high level
* Solid hands\-on experience with modern AI platforms and tools, with enough technical depth to understand, evaluate, and challenge solutions without needing to write production code
* Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate value clearly and persuasively
* Highly proactive, self\-directed and team player who brings fresh ideas for user adoption, churn mitigation and expansion
* Demonstrated ability to share expertise, develop best practices and contribute to the broader success of the team

new_jobs.title: Business Operations
new_jobs.description:
**About Roger**  

Roger is an AI platform that frees home health clinicians from paperwork so they can focus on what matters: delivering life\-changing care to our most vulnerable elderly patients in the comfort of their homes. Backed by leading healthcare investors like SignalFire, we've powered millions of visits, deployed to thousands of clinicians, and we're just getting started.

**Job Overview**  

We are looking for Business Operations team members to join our early team. This is a role for a sharp, scrappy operator who wants to learn the business by working in it. Depending on company needs, you will be placed in one area of the business, such as customer operations, revenue operations, people operations, or hiring, and own it end to end.


You will work directly with founders and team leads, and there may be opportunities to take on work in other areas over time as the company grows. This is not a narrow role with a rigid playbook. You will figure things out, build systems, and take real ownership of your area.


You need to be genuinely curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by the idea that no problem is "not your job."

**What You Might Work On**  

Your focus will shift as the company grows. You may dive into any of these areas:

* **Hiring:** Step in as an interim hiring manager, run interview loops, track the data, and manage agency and recruiter relationships.
* **People Ops:** Own employee onboarding, support HR processes, and help build the systems that keep a growing team running smoothly.
* **Revenue Operations:** Manage our sales tools, clean and maintain CRM data, and set up workflows and automations that make the GTM team faster.
* **Customer and Support Operations:** Partner with our success and support teams on scheduling, tracking, and process improvements, and help investigate customer issues across teams.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Work with engineering, finance, and leadership to unblock projects and keep things moving.
* **Special Projects:** Build dashboards and metrics for the C\-suite, run analyses, and take on whatever high\-priority project comes up next.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Take projects from ambiguous idea to finished result with minimal oversight.
* **Operational Execution:** Keep the details straight: follow\-ups, record\-keeping, and coordination so nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Systems Building:** Spot broken or manual processes and replace them with clean, scalable workflows.
* **Data and Insights:** Build dashboards, track key metrics, and surface insights that help leadership make better decisions.
* **Cross\-Team Partnership:** Work closely with founders and team leads, and be the person people rely on to get things done.
* **Fast Learning:** Quickly pick up new tools, domains, and workflows, including how home health works and where Roger fits into it.

**Requirements:**

* **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional experience, with prior startup experience required. Backgrounds in operations, RevOps, BizOps, customer success, or similar roles are a strong fit.
* **Fast Learner:** Picks up unfamiliar domains, tools, and processes quickly. Healthcare exposure is a plus but not required.
* **Detail Oriented:** Catches the small things others miss, keeps clean records, and takes pride in precision.
* **Strong Communicator:** Clear, warm, and professional with teammates, candidates, customers, and leadership.
* **Data Comfortable:** Able to work in dashboards, CRMs, and spreadsheets, and use data to spot opportunities.
* **Startup Generalist:** Comfortable with ambiguity, motivated by mission, and energized by ownership in a fast\-paced environment. Eager to jump into any part of the business and execute well.

**Why Join Us?**  

Platinum health, dental, and vision insurance  

Unlimited PTO  

Retirement: 401(k) plan  

Unmatched career growth as an early hire, with exposure to every part of the business  

Work on a mission that matters, backed by AI innovation and top\-tier investors

**Make a Real Difference \- Hear from our Users:**  

"If I had to give Roger a rating out of 10, I'd give it an 11! You guys changed my life!!" \- G.M. from San Francisco, Registered Nurse  

"Roger AI saves me hours per day. I can easily focus on my patients now too." \- J.L. from Tucson, Registered Nurse  

"Being a single mom is tough, but with Roger I can take the time to go to my daughter's soccer game and also pursue further education." \- T.M. from Dallas, Licensed Vocational Nurse


Compensation Range: $110K \- $160K

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**


Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

 **About the role**


Crowe’s Metals \& Materials Consulting practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Consultant** to help shape the future of our D365 practice. This role offers the opportunity to lead solution architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and work directly with finance and operations leaders across manufacturing and distribution organizations.

  

If you want meaningful impact, autonomy, and a clear path to practice leadership, this is a strategic career opportunity—not just another consulting role.

 **What You Will Lead and Influence**

* Architect and lead end\-to\-end D365 Finance solutions that deliver measurable outcomes for mid\-market and enterprise clients.
* Advise senior stakeholders, including CFOs and Operations leaders, to define requirements and design transformation roadmaps.
* Set solution direction and guide delivery teams to ensure projects meet scope, quality, and client expectations.
* Lead functional design, feature optimization, data integrity, and user experience improvements to maximize platform value.
* Participate in quality reviews and steer project teams through design, prototyping, and deployment phases.
* Contribute to Crowe’s methodologies, accelerators, and best practices; mentor team members; and support the growth of our D365 offering.
* Engage in team\-building and internal initiatives, leveraging non\-client time for personal development and practice enhancement.

 **What Makes Crowe a Strong Career Move**

* **High\-impact role** with direct influence on solution strategy and client outcomes.
* **Rapidly growing D365 Finance practice** backed by a nationally recognized consulting brand.
* **Clear advancement path** into Solution Architect, Industry Lead, or Practice Leadership roles.
* **Strong investment in your development** (certification support, training, conferences, thought leadership opportunities).
* **Collaborative culture** that values quality, innovation, and balanced workloads.
* **Flexible work environment** with predictable, project\-based travel (25%–50%).

 **Experience That Makes You Successful (Must\-Have)**

* Bachelors degree required.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on D365 Finance implementation leadership or equivalent ERP delivery experience.
* Proven track record delivering complex, full\-lifecycle D365 Finance projects.
* Strong functional expertise across core finance and operational modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash/Bank, Reporting, etc.).
* Ability to lead solution architecture, translate requirements into actionable designs, and guide teams through execution.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, produce high\-quality work products, and lead engagements with minimal oversight.

 **Preferred**

* Experience in Manufacturing or Distribution environments; Metals industry exposure highly valued.
* Strong functional expertise across operational modules (Procurement, Inventory, etc.).
* Experience with complementary ISV solutions within the D365 ecosystem.
* D365 certifications in Finance or related modules; CPA, CMA, or CFA a plus.
* Prior consulting experience within a professional services environment.

 **Why You’ll Thrive Here**

* Opportunity to shape the direction of the D365 practice.
* Access to diverse and challenging client environments.
* Supportive leadership that values initiative and thought leadership.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

new_jobs.description:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical\-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value\-based\-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality\-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50\+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48\-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi\-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short\-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution\-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost\-per\-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under\-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well\-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross\-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

**Adoption.** Shipping is half the job. You own whether features are actually used: rollout plans, in\-product guidance, enablement materials and documentation, adoption targets per release, and follow\-up on the ones that miss. A feature sitting at 11% adoption is an open problem, not a completed ticket.

**Practices.** Help raise how the whole product function works — brief and spec templates, definition of ready and done, the decision log, the metrics review. We're building the PM layer close to from scratch, and you'll leave real fingerprints on it.

What we're looking for

**Required**

* 3–5 years as a product manager, **including healthcare product experience** — clinical workflow, care management, population health, digital health, RCM, or an equivalent regulated clinical domain
* Hands\-on experience owning **integrations with third\-party systems** — EHRs, clearinghouses, device or telephony vendors, data partners — and a clear point of view on what makes an integration feel seamless to the user and observable to the team running it
* A track record of shipping: features that reached production and changed a number you can name
* Experience with workflow\-heavy products used by demanding daily users under time pressure
* Strong discovery instincts — you go to where the work happens rather than relying on tickets and secondhand requests
* Fluency with metrics. You can define them, instrument them, question them, and resist the pretty ones that don't drive decisions
* Excellent written communication. We run on written briefs, specs, and decisions across several time zones
* Comfort owning a release process: coordinating QA, managing scope under deadline, and being accountable when it slips
* Enough technical depth to hold a real design discussion with engineers — you don't need to code, but you do need to understand what you're asking for
* Authorized to work in the US

**A strong plus**

* Working knowledge of quality measures and gap closure (HEDIS or similar) — specs, eligibility, evidence, measurement per

**Become Part of Our Team and Help Us Help People**

Interested in doing good, working with smart people, and innovating with proven technologies? At Diona, we’re re\-inventing how health and human services programs can be delivered. It’s hard work but rewarding \- and with you, we can be even better.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join Diona's Mobile Solutions Services team supporting state health and human services agencies. Diona is a configuration\-driven mobile platform that supports workers in the field and the individuals and families who rely on benefit and support programs. The Business Analyst works directly with the customer to translate real\-world business processes into a working Diona\-based solution, bridging the gap between agency needs and out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) product capability. Your expertise will help implement Diona’s mobile solutions that improve lives—be part of this meaningful journey today!

**What You'll Do**

· Work directly with customer stakeholders to identify and document existing business processes

· Map identified business processes to Diona's OOTB configuration capabilities, identifying where standard functionality directly meets the need and where additional configuration is required

· Elaborate high\-level requirements into detailed specifications, working with customer stakeholders and the delivery team to resolve open questions and edge cases

· Write clear, implementation\-ready user stories that guide the Senior Engineer's configuration and integration work

· Serve as the day\-to\-day requirements owner throughout the implementation lifecycle, from discovery through go\-live

· Assign and direct testing tasks to the Tester based on completed user stories

· Collaborate with the Solution Architect and Senior Engineer on solution design decisions, particularly where business process interpretation can impact the technical approach

We are seeking an energetic and detail\-oriented Mobile Business Analyst to join our team.

· 4–8 years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, or business process mapping, with an eagerness to grow into greater ownership of the BA function on an implementation

· Willingness to work closely with and learn from the Solution Architect and Senior Engineer, particularly early on, while building deep familiarity with the product

· Strong motivation to become a subject\-matter expert on the platform's configuration capabilities

· Sound judgment and professionalism in managing customer expectations and scope throughout an engagement

· Strong user story writing skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, testable requirements

· Comfort in working directly with external customer stakeholders, including non\-technical staff

· Ability to understand and reason about configuration\-driven software and conditional business rule logic — no coding experience required

· Experience supporting one or more public sector health and human services programs — such as economic/benefits programs, Child Support, or Child Welfare — along with the ability to learn new program areas as engagements require

The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. This role is accountable for oversight and effectiveness of change control, Computer System Validation (CSV), including validation of GxP\-relevant software, AI\-assisted/low\-code/no\-code tools, and native\-built applications, risk management, supplier/vendor quality, deviation/complaint handling, CAPA, internal auditing, and training.  The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. Leadership \& QMS Governance

Description:

Quantum Sky is searching for an **Instructional Designer** supporting the Marine Corps Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) Operations and Sustainment (O\&S) program. You will work closely with the training team, customer stakeholders, and technical subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure training materials remain current as ITSM processes, workflows, and system capabilities evolve.
