------------------------

* Design and develop interactive computer\-based courseware for technical and end\-user training.
* Convert complex technical information, workflows, and requirements into clear instructional content.
* Develop storyboards, flow diagrams, scenarios, simulations, and supporting training materials.
* Create and update CBTs, JIT videos, QRGs, and Job Aids.
* Ensure training products remain aligned with current BMC Remedy/Helix functionality and USMC ITSM processes.

**Stakeholder and SME Collaboration**
-------------------------------------

* Work directly with technical SMEs and customer stakeholders to understand system changes, process updates, and new training requirements.
* Validate the technical accuracy and usability of instructional content.
* Participate in reviews, demonstrations, and working sessions with program and customer teams.

**Training Environment Support**
--------------------------------

* Support validation of training environments against production configurations.
* Coordinate with technical teams to test training procedures and system workflows.
* Help ensure courseware remains synchronized with system releases and configuration changes.

**Project and Quality Support**
-------------------------------

* Develop work plans, schedules, estimates, and status updates for assigned training activities.
* Track assigned deliverables through completion and provide input to weekly and monthly program reporting.
* Participate in peer reviews and quality checks of training products.
* Maintain consistency with established style, quality, and instructional\-design standards.
* Maintain training records and documentation supporting CMMI and internal quality processes.

**Training products include:*** SCORM 2004\-compliant Computer\-Based Training (CBT) modules developed using the Marine Corps Systems Approach to Training (SAT) methodology and ADDIE model.
* Just\-in\-Time (JIT) training videos covering core CBT and system functionality.
* Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), Job Aids, and other end\-user support materials.


Qualifications:
**Required:*** 5\+ years of applicable instructional\-design, training\-development, or technical\-training experience.
* A. or B.S. degree in Instructional Design, Business, Organizational Development, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing technical training for government, DoD, or large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience using Adobe Captivate and Adobe editing tools, including Audition, and the Microsoft Office suite.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification and strong operational knowledge of the ITIL framework.
* Experience developing SCORM\-compliant eLearning materials.
* Ability to quickly learn technical software platforms and translate system functionality into effective user training.
* Strong written communication, editing, facilitation, and organizational skills.
* Experience developing branched learning scenarios, simulations, and interactive training.
* Experience working with SMEs to validate technical content.
* Familiarity with training environments, software releases, testing, and configuration changes.
* Adobe Captivate and/or Articulate 360 experience.

**Desired:*** Experience with BMC Remedy, BMC Helix, ServiceNow, or another enterprise ITSM platform.
* Experience supporting USMC or DoD ITSM environments.
* Familiarity with Marine Corps SAT / ADDIE methodology.
* Experience developing training for software migrations or major system modernization efforts.
* Experience with AI\-enabled content development, knowledge management, or training automation.
* Master's degree in Instructional Design, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Certified Technical Trainer (CTT\+) or another relevant industry training certification.

**Clearance:*** Active Secret clearance required.

**Location:*** The work location will be remote with some potential limited travel to Quantico, Virginia, as required.
